If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>US</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until October 13, 2026.</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>The Global GTM Strategy, Planning and Operations team at Cloudflare supports our high-growth Sales organization through scalable, AI supported GTM planning and operations. We focus on thoughtful planning of sales capacity, segmentation, territory carving, quota setting, and compensation design while ensuring clear rules of engagement for our Sales Team. Our goal is to establish a cohesive, consistent process framework that can support high growth, enable the Company's strategy, and accelerate Cloudflare's leadership in the developer and AI-native business segments.</p> <p>As the Senior Principal, Sales Compensation Design &amp; Strategy, you will design and manage Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plans across all customer facing teams including Sales, Technical Sales, Partner Sales, and Customer Success &amp; Experience, to ensure they are motivating, aligned with Cloudflare's strategy, and industry leading. This is a high visibility role with significant executive engagement, including leading C-level discussions with our CRO, CFO, CPO, and COO, and serving as the design authority on the Executive Compensation Steering Committee.</p> <p>You will architect new compensation metrics that reflect how Cloudflare monetizes a developer first, AI supportive business - including consumption, adoption, and platform attach - and ensure roles, territories, and quotas align with compensation plans to achieve our GTM objectives. You will establish a governance framework for efficient compensation planning and partner closely with the Compensation Administration and Operations Teams to ensure effective implementation and accurate payouts. A strong understanding of SaaS bookings, monetization approaches, and consumption and adoption models is essential.</p> <p>The scope of executive influence, the architectural work required to support our developer/AI business model, and the AI-native transformation of the compensation design function make this seat fundamental to our GTM execution strategy.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Executive Leadership &amp; Design Authority</p> <ul> <li>Lead the Sales Compensation Design Process with the Executive Steering Committee, including CRO, CFO, and CPO level stakeholders.</li> <li>Drive C-level discussions on compensation philosophy, pay-for-performance outcomes, and strategic trade-offs; develop recommendation decks and own the narrative through approval.</li> <li>Architect new metrics that align seller incentives with Cloudflare's developer platform and AI product strategy (e.g., Workers consumption, AI Gateway adoption, platform attach, multi-product penetration).</li> <li>Create a 3-year roadmap for the Sales Compensation Design function.</li> </ul> <p>AI-Native Compensation Design</p> <ul> <li>Build the AI Compensation Design Framework and Application - an internal capability that uses AI to accelerate plan modeling, scenario simulation, payout forecasting, and what-if analysis across thousands of sellers and territories.</li> <li>Leverage AI to design high-quality SPIFFs and incentive structures, including generating candidate designs, simulating seller behavior, and stress-testing against historical data before launch.</li> <li>Track ROI of comp plans, SPIFFs, and incentive programs using AI-driven analytics - moving from lagging reporting to predictive measurement of plan effectiveness, seller behavior change, and revenue lift.</li> <li>Develop AI-powered pay-for-performance reporting that surfaces insights for executives, managers, and sellers in real time, replacing static quarterly reviews with continuous intelligence.</li> </ul> <p>Cross-Functional Execution</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with GTM Strategy, Operations, Finance, HR, IT, and Product to ensure effective deployment of compensation plans and GTM strategy.</li> <li>Lead compensation enablement and change management for the global Sales team, including AI-assisted communications, FAQ generation, and plan-acceptance workflows.</li> <li>Design SPIFFs and incentive strategies that balance long-term strategic bets with short-term revenue goals.</li> <li>Partner with the Compensation Administration and Operations Teams to ensure design intent translates into accurate, auditable payouts.</li> </ul> <p>Required Experience &amp; Skills</p> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in Sales Compensation Design in a fast-paced tech company or as a management consultant.</li> <li>Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and AI-augmented workflows - whether through prior comp design work, analytics, or strategic projects. Comfort building or directing the build of AI-powered internal applications is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including the ability to architect new metrics for emerging business models (consumption, AI monetization).</li> <li>Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with proven experience presenting to and influencing C-level executives.</li> <li>Proven experience driving Executive Steering Committee meetings and owning the decision narrative end-to-end.</li> <li>Experience leading cross-functional initiatives to completion across Finance, HR, IT, Product, and GTM.</li> <li>Detail-oriented with a strategic mindset.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <p>The ideal candidate combines a strong background in sales strategy and compensation design with genuine curiosity about applying AI to transform the function. Candidates will have exceptional stakeholder management skills, executive presence, and the confidence to manage evolving strategies in a high-growth company.&nbsp;</p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $230,000 - $317,000</li> <li>For California (excluding Bay Area), Washington, Washington DC, NY and NJ based hires: $220,000 - $303,000</li> <li>For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $200,000 - $275,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health &amp; Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility &amp; Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life &amp; Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.&nbsp; More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. &nbsp;We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. &nbsp;All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. &nbsp;Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. title: Associate Vice President, Interoperability Engineering
jd_text: Become a part of our caring community The Associate VP, Interoperability Engineering devises an effective strategy for executing and delivering on IT business initiatives. The Associate VP, Interoperability Engineering requires a in-depth understanding of how organization capabilities interrelate across segments and/or enterprise-wide. The Associate Vice President, Technology Solutions – Interoperability Engineering serves as the enterprise technology leader responsible for advancing Humana's interoperability engineering strategy, platforms, and delivery capabilities. This role partners across business, technology, architecture, security, and operations organizations to define and execute the long-term vision for interoperability as a strategic enterprise capability. The AVP, Interoperability Engineering is accountable for engineering execution, data acquisition platform modernization, reusable platform services, and enterprise interoperability transformation initiatives. This leader will evolve interoperability beyond traditional data exchange by establishing scalable enterprise platforms, API ecosystems, automation capabilities, and developer services that enable both regulatory compliance and emerging business opportunities. Working within a highly matrixed environment, the AVP drives strategic planning, operational excellence, engineering modernization, and organizational capability development while ensuring technology investments align with enterprise priorities, architecture standards, and future regulatory direction. Key Responsibilities Technology Leadership Serve as the strategic technology leader for Interoperability Engineering, establishing vision, priorities, and execution strategies that align with enterprise objectives. Lead large-scale modernization and transformation initiatives while fostering a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. Interoperability Strategy & Platform Vision Define and execute the long-term interoperability roadmap, target architecture, and enterprise platform strategy. Expand interoperability capabilities beyond data exchange into reusable enterprise services including APIs, developer platforms, automation frameworks, data acquisition capabilities, and integration services. Anticipate regulatory and market trends, ensuring Humana is prepared to rapidly respond to evolving interoperability requirements. Engineering & Delivery Excellence Establish modern engineering practices, governance models, quality standards, and performance metrics that drive predictable delivery outcomes. Accelerate adoption of AI-enabled engineering solutions, automation, and DevSecOps practices across the software development lifecycle. Drive engineering efficiency and scalability through reusable services, standardized platforms, and automation capabilities. Establish platform governance, engineering standards, service management practices, and operational accountability across APIs, integrations, developer services, and data acquisition platforms. Ensure platforms are designed to support enterprise-scale growth, evolving regulatory requirements, and increased business demand. Develop measurable service-level objectives and operational performance indicators that support continuous improvement and business confidence. Enterprise Standards & Ecosystem Leadership Define, govern, and continuously evolve enterprise interoperability standards, integration frameworks, API management practices, and reusable platform patterns. Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Product, and business stakeholders to establish and maintain enterprise-wide interoperability capabilities. Lead Humana's adoption and advancement of industry standards and best practices, including FHIR, HL7, CAQH, and emerging interoperability technologies. Financial, Workforce & Vendor Governance Develop and execute workforce, investment, and sourcing strategies that strengthen Humana's long-term interoperability engineering capabilities. Build deeper internal technical expertise in strategic capability areas. Leverage strategic partners selectively to accelerate modernization, enhance capabilities, and provide specialized expertise while ensuring critical knowledge remains institutionalized within the organization. Talent Development & Organizational Leadership Build and lead a high-performing engineering organization focused on technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and customer-focused outcomes. Develop engineering leaders and associates through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and career development opportunities. Strengthen organizational depth in platform engineering, interoperability standards, cloud technologies, APIs, automation, and emerging technologies. Create an environment that attracts, develops, and retains top engineering talent while fostering continuous learning and professional growth. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc. $189,400 - $260,500 per year This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance. Description of Benefits Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities. jd_text: Career-defining. Life-changing. At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career About This Role: iRhythm is currently seeking an experienced Senior Technical Project Manager within the Research & Development team. You will have the opportunity to drive the delivery of medical device projects to domestic and international markets. You will be exposed to a diverse set of projects involving development and testing in the context of addressing unmet clinical needs. In addition, you will build a deep understanding of our end-to-end systems, helping to drive successful delivery of projects throughout the development life cycle. Our work environment is fast-paced, with a collaborative atmosphere. Most of all, we are passionate about delivering innovations that improve the quality of health care and the patient experience. We are looking for like-minded individuals to join our team today! The Technical Project Manager – DevOps leads complex initiatives that improve software delivery, cloud infrastructure, automation, reliability, and operational efficiency. This role partners closely with DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Software Engineering, Security, QA, IT, and Product teams to plan and execute technical initiatives from strategy through implementation. The Technical Project Manager is responsible for driving delivery across multiple technical workstreams, managing dependencies and risks, establishing execution plans, and providing visibility to technical and executive stakeholders. Key Responsibilities DevOps Program & Project Leadership Lead end-to-end delivery of complex DevOps and cloud infrastructure initiatives. Develop project plans, milestones, schedules, dependencies, and execution strategies. Coordinate multiple engineering teams and technical workstreams to achieve delivery objectives. Drive execution against committed timelines and proactively address delivery risks. Facilitate technical planning, execution reviews, status meetings, and leadership escalations. CI/CD & Software Delivery Partner with DevOps and engineering teams to improve CI/CD pipelines and software delivery processes. Coordinate initiatives involving build, integration, automated testing, deployment, and release automation. Track implementation of deployment strategies, environment management, and automated release processes. Identify bottlenecks in the software delivery lifecycle and coordinate improvement initiatives. Support adoption of standardized development and deployment practices across engineering teams. Cloud & Infrastructure Delivery Coordinate projects involving cloud infrastructure, platforms, environments, networking, compute, storage, and supporting services. Partner with cloud and infrastructure engineers to manage technical dependencies and implementation plans. Coordinate cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization, platform upgrades, and environment improvements. Track infrastructure readiness and dependencies required to support application releases. Automation & Platform Engineering Lead initiatives to improve infrastructure and deployment automation. Coordinate adoption of Infrastructure as Code and configuration-management practices. Support implementation of standardized DevOps tooling and engineering platforms. Drive initiatives that improve scalability, reliability, deployment frequency, and operational efficiency. Security & Compliance Coordinate DevSecOps initiatives with Security, Engineering, and Infrastructure teams. Ensure security requirements and controls are incorporated into technical delivery plans. Track vulnerability remediation, security dependencies, and required technical approvals. Coordinate security testing and compliance activities associated with DevOps initiatives. Cross-Functional Technical Leadership Serve as the primary project-management interface between DevOps and partner organizations. Coordinate across Software Engineering, Firmware, QA, Security, Product, IT, Operations, and Architecture teams. title: TACOM (RRAD): Computer Systems Analyst II (Contingency)
jd_text: Title: TACOM (RRAD): Computer Systems Analyst II (Contingency) Program Summary The U.S. Army Tank-automotive and Armaments Command (TACOM) sustains the Army’s mission to develop, acquire, field, and sustain ground combat, tactical, and support systems throughout their lifecycle. The program focuses on ensuring operational readiness, reliability, and safety of automotive and ground support equipment critical to Army operations. Under this contract, personnel provide maintenance, repair, overhaul, and sustainment support in accordance with Army technical manuals, safety standards, and performance requirements. Job Summary The Computer Systems Analyst II analyzes, designs, and supports information systems to meet TACOM mission and operational requirements. This role evaluates system performance, identifies improvements, and ensures that hardware, software, and network solutions function effectively and securely. This position works with limited supervision, performs moderately complex system analysis tasks, and may provide guidance to junior personnel. This position is contingent upon award Roles and Responsibilities Proposes and develops automated reports using the Logistics Modernization Program’s Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Enterprise Central Component (ECC), or the Workload Planning and Reporting Module or associated systems to improve data collection, reporting, analysis, and forecasting. Uses model-based software to analyze and prepare reports for analysis. Establishes rapport with production functions to analyze, verify, and correct workload data ensuring data availability of workload factors including parts, production orders, labor hours and timekeeping, schedules, etc. Maintains products and reports between LMP and manual and automated systems which establish, implement, maintain, and evaluate (a.) operating or mission programs of the depot; (b.) pertinent administrative or support programs of the depot; (c.) integration of the programs; and (d.) their interrelationships with the related support functions of the depot. Provides advice on the development, testing, and roll out decisions to depot personnel with input from independent contractors, higher headquarters, and Army guidance. Performs a variety of duties involving various automated supply systems supporting depot organizations and tenant activities. Works independently utilizing skills, knowledge, and abilities such as interview, use of appropriate analytical and investigative management techniques, systems and procedures analyses, forms and reports analysis, work simplifications, statistical analysis, ADP systems analysis, supply systems analysis and similar techniques in the study, development, evaluation, revision, or improvement of depot programs and procedures necessary for efficient and economical accomplishment. Incumbent may be requested to perform any one or all the following functions independently. Conducts studies and audits of depot performance, compliance, and progress toward improvement of objectives and efficiency in a variety of supply management programs. Management studies/audits involve a comprehensive evaluation of managerial and ADP systems functions resulting in a wide impact on depot organizations. Studies may be assigned or conducted on initiative of analysts and require an extensive knowledge of depot mission and supply functions and a thorough knowledge of the uses and potential uses of ADP systems and automation to interface with mission and supply systems accomplishment. Makes judgmental recommendations for changes in work/supply systems, sometimes recommending significant departure from established or regulatory procedures. Detailed study in draft form is submitted to supervisor for review and in final form to concerned management officials/depot commander, with analysis available for discussion, advice, and service upon implementation. Serves as consultant to management and staff elements concerning assigned supply systems and program problems and provide recommendations of solution based on own judgment. Serves as system analyst and advisor/consultant in the installation supply, property accountability, and equipment authorization and transportation management programs, in the design, development, and maintenance of new and existing systems/programs. Analyzes system processing problems and provides technical assistance to functional personnel to alleviate these problems. As assigned, represents the depot at higher command meetings to exchange information and coordinate functional program/system objectives, clarify depot policy and directives, and resolve controversial problems. Coordinate minor and complex design changes to supply systems and functional procedures with associated directorates on depot, with headquarters, and vendors to assure continuity and to enable trouble-free transitions. Serves as depot point of contact for each current assigned program and overall functional and system coordinator for program redesign and development through interface with Directorate of Information Management programmers and external system design agencies. Plans and coordinates statistical reporting and record keeping related to installation supply accounting and management, analyzes to detect deficiencies within the directorate and in supporting divisions, and other depot activities supporting the directorate. Reports findings and develop recommendations for procedural and regulatory changes using own judgment and knowledge of the system and regulations. Develops informative material detailing relating to such factors as organization or responsibility, correlation of activities, including those at higher echelons and control points, interpretation of new or revised regulations, etc. Presents material in written or charted form for dissemination or presents as a contribution for directorate of command presentations and meetings. Analyzes methods of attaining established program objectives and reviewing supply management systems. Develop guidelines and procedures to facilitate accomplishments. Develops training programs and provides instruction. Advises management and functional personnel on system requirements and limitations to systems to assist users in defining problems and needs. This requires a broad knowledge and understanding of logistics systems flow, terminology, and interrelationships with those systems (both local unique and standard) which interface with Army Material Command Installation Supply System (AMCISS), Standard Depot Systems (SDS) and other division Systems. Performs other duties as assigned. Basic Qualifications Education/Experience: High school diploma or GED. Must be computer literate and proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Power Point. Knowledge of a broad range of supply program relationships to monitor automated programs to determine their efficiency in meeting established information requirements and recommend changes in data flow, sources of input, report formats, and calculations to satisfy supply management information needs. Knowledge of specialized methods and techniques to analyze and evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of supply integrated systems. Ability to analyze and resolve difficult issues and problems in supply data management, i.e., accept requests for system changes, conduct research to determine the validity of requests, refine the information provided, and prepare specifications for computer specialists to use in programming, testing, and implementing changes in automated supply systems in collaboration with computer specialists, they evaluate problems with new and modified systems, including the logical flow, input errors, interconnections among data fields and program elements within a flow of related programs, and recommend solutions to both supply and computer specialists. Skill in analytical reasoning and the ability to apply that skill to the identification, analysis, and resolution of budgetary and workforce utilization problems. Knowledge of analytical and evaluative techniques. Knowledge of budgeting/accounting practices, internal support programs, depot support functions, and automated systems. Skill in applying such techniques to studies concerning the efficiency and effectiveness of operating and administrative programs, including pertinent manual and automated systems. Knowledge of major issues, program goals and objectives, direct labor work processes, and major administrative operations of the depot; their integration; and their interrelationships with the related support functions of the Depot and its tenants. Ability to obtain or maintain a U.S. Government security clearance (as required) U.S. citizenship required Preferred Qualifications Previous experience supporting DoD, Army, or TACOM programs Prior government contracting experience Additional Information This position will be performed in office, data center, or operational environment that requires prolonged sitting, computer use, and occasional movement within facilities. Employees may also be required to work shifts, overtime, or weekend support based on mission needs. KBR Benefits KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development. Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture. These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company. That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together. KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Lead Technical Product Manager – Commerce Platform
jd_text: Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future. We are looking for an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager to help define the strategy for our global Commerce Platform. The Commerce Platform provides foundational capabilities that power Levi's digital commerce experiences across channels and markets. These capabilities span areas including product and inventory, cart and checkout, payments, promotions, identity, search, analytics, observability, and the services and integrations that connect our broader commerce ecosystem. We are undergoing a significant transformation, evolving from a legacy monolithic commerce platform to a modern architecture built on domain-driven services, APIs, event-driven integration, and reusable platform capabilities. As the Lead Technical Product Manager, you will define the strategy and roadmap for key Commerce Platform capabilities, partnering closely with Engineering, Architecture, Digital Product, and business stakeholders to turn customer and commercial needs into scalable technical solutions. Beyond gathering and prioritizing requirements, you will help shape the platform's future. This includes identifying opportunities for reusable platform capabilities, addressing architectural and process constraints, prioritizing investments that unlock long-term value, and balancing short-term needs against long-term scalability and complexity. You will bring product judgment, technical fluency, and curiosity. You are comfortable operating in a changing landscape, digging into complex systems and business processes, challenging assumptions, and bringing structure and direction to problems that cross technical boundaries. About the Job Technical Product Roadmap • Build and evolve the product strategy for defined capabilities within the Commerce Platform. • Translate customer, business, and commercial needs into scalable technical products and platform capabilities. • Partner with Engineering and Architecture to shape platform strategy, identifying opportunities to unlock value through new technologies and architectural capabilities while proactively addressing technical constraints, tradeoffs, and long-term risks. • Balance near-term needs with foundational platform investments, technical health, scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability. • Build toward reusable, configurable platform capabilities rather than market-, channel-, or use-case-specific implementations. • Identify opportunities to simplify the platform, reduce duplication, and establish clearer product and domain boundaries. • Define clear product outcomes and success measures and use them to guide roadmap decisions. Product Discovery, Definition & Execution • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for the platform capabilities you own, from discovery and strategy through implementation, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. • Partner with teams to understand the underlying problem, desired outcome, and value rather than simply translating requests into features. • Work with engineers and architects to translate product strategy into clear technical requirements and executable work. • Manage the product backlog, including epics, user stories, requirements, acceptance criteria, and sequencing. • Ensure teams have business and technical context to make implementation decisions. • Make prioritization and trade-off decisions across scope, value, cost, technical complexity, risk, and time to market. • Track outcomes after launch and use insights, adoption, operational data, and partner feedback to inform future investment. Platform Architecture & Capability Development • Partner with Engineering and Architecture to evolve Commerce Platform capabilities toward modular, scalable, and reusable services. • Champion API-first, domain-driven, and event-driven approaches where they create clearer boundaries and more reusable capabilities. • Help define clear contracts and interfaces between platform capabilities and their consumers. • Ensure roadmap decisions account for technical health, performance, scalability, resiliency, security, observability, and extensibility alongside new functionality. • Help guide the transition from legacy commerce capabilities to next-generation services while balancing modernization with ongoing needs. • Evaluate technology and vendor capabilities based on their ability to support the broader platform strategy rather than individual feature requirements alone. Dependency & Ecosystem Management • Lead the dependency picture for the products and capabilities you manage. • Identify upstream and downstream systems, consumers, and teams affected by product and platform changes. • Treat incomplete dependency understanding as a product risk and uncover dependencies during discovery and planning rather than during implementation. • Partner with Engineering and Architecture to reduce dependencies structurally , favoring clear contracts, stable interfaces, reusable capabilities, and asynchronous integration. • Sequence roadmap projects realistically around dependencies that remain and work with partner teams to establish commitments and shared expectations. • Ensure changes account for the broader commerce ecosystem, including product information, inventory, order management, identity, payments, fraud, pricing and promotions, search, analytics, and customer data. • Build productive relationships with the teams and partners whose systems your products consume or promote. Cross-Functional Product Leadership • Be a trusted partner to Engineering Managers, Staff and Principal Engineers, Architects, Product Managers, and partners. • Partner with customer-facing Product teams to understand their roadmaps and identify where shared Commerce Platform capabilities can ensure experiences or use cases. • Build agreement across partners when priorities, requirements, or desired solutions differ. • Provide strategic advice on how platform capabilities can address our challenges, including when the right answer is a trade-off, an alternative solution, or not building something. • Communicate product strategy, roadmap, priorities, decisions, risks, and outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences. • Represent Commerce Platform capabilities in planning and roadmap conversations with senior leaders and partner organizations. • Build relationships with external vendors and technology partners and ensure their capabilities and roadmaps align with our platform strategy. Data, Outcomes & Continuous Improvement • Define measurable outcomes and KPIs for platform investments, including adoption, reliability, performance, operational efficiency, developer experience, and growth. • Use product, operational, and engineering data to inform prioritization and investment decisions. • Measure the adoption and value of platform capabilities rather than treating technical delivery as the definition of success. • Identify opportunities to reduce friction for teams consuming Commerce Platform capabilities. • Evaluate industry trends, new technologies, and commerce platform capabilities that could influence the roadmap. • Explore opportunities to use automation and AI to improve platform capabilities, product discovery, engineering productivity, documentation, and operational processes. • Be an agent of change, challenging existing assumptions and processes when better approaches can improve customer, business, or engineering outcomes. About You • 8+ years of experience in Technical Product Management, Product Management for technical platforms, or a related role. • Experience managing product strategy and roadmaps for complex technical products or platform capabilities. • Technical fluency and demonstrated ability to participate in architecture and system design conversations. • Experience working closely with software engineers and architects on APIs, distributed systems, integrations, and modern platform architectures. • Understand complex systems, identify upstream and downstream dependencies, and reason about how product decisions affect a broader technology ecosystem. • Experience translating ambiguous business and technical problems into clear product strategies, requirements, roadmaps, and executable backlogs. • Balance customer and value with technical health, scalability, maintainability, cost, and delivery complexity. • Experience using data to support product decisions and measure outcomes. • Influence across multiple teams and organizational boundaries. • Experience communicating complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts and trade-offs to senior business and technology leaders. • Comfortable bringing clarity, structure, and momentum to complex problems. • Experience building technical products or platform capabilities within digital commerce, retail, or another large-scale transactional ecosystem. • Experience with commerce platform modernization, migration, or replatforming programs. • Familiarity with commerce technologies such as SAP Commerce (Hybris), SCAYLE, or other headless or composable commerce platforms. • Experience with domain-driven design, API-first platforms, event-driven architectures, and modern integration patterns. • Familiarity with commerce domains such as product information, inventory, cart, checkout, payments, fraud, promotions, identity, search, order management, and analytics. • Experience building platforms or services consumed by multiple products, channels, markets, or engineering teams. • Experience working in global environments with distributed engineering and product teams. • Experience managing strategic relationships with technology vendors and external partners. • Experience using AI and automation to improve product management, engineering productivity, or platform operations. What Success Is A successful Lead Technical Product Manager will: • Establish a clear roadmap for the Commerce Platform capabilities they own. • Become a trusted product partner to Engineering, Architecture, Digital Product, and business leadership. • Turn recurring business and channel needs into reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off implementations. • Improve understanding between customer-facing product roadmaps and the underlying platform investments needed to promote them. • Identify dependencies and architectural constraints early and help reduce them over time. • Make technical health, scalability, reliability, and operational readiness visible product priorities. • Create clear measures of adoption and value for platform capabilities and use those measures to inform future investment. • Help evolve Commerce Platform toward clearer domain boundaries and a more modular, scalable architecture. • Help product and engineering teams to deliver new commerce experiences faster by making the underlying platform easier to understand, consume, and extend. The expected starting salary range for this role is $170,000 - $200,000 per year. We may pay more or less than the posted range based on the location of the role. The amount a particular employee will earn within the salary range will be based on factors such as relevant education, qualifications, performance and business needs. Levi Strauss & Co. (LS&Co.) offers a total rewards package that includes base pay, incentive plans, 401(k) matching, paid leave, health insurance, product discounts, and more designed to help you and your family stay healthy, meet your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. Available benefits and incentive compensation vary depending upon the specifics of the role; details relating to a specific role will be made available upon request. Read more about our benefits here . LS&Co. is an affirmative action and equal employment opportunity employer. We welcome and value people from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences to make LS&Co. a collective success. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require current or future employment visa sponsorship. We do not participate in the H-1B cap lottery or sponsor initial employment visas. Candidates with an existing H-1B visa that is eligible for transfer may be considered. #LI-Remote EOE M/F/Disability/Vets LOCATION Remote - USA FULL TIME/PART TIME Full time FILL DATE This position is expected to be filled by 12/14/2026. title: Supply Chain & Manufacturing Manager, Collectibles
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About Crunchyroll</h2> <p>Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.</p> <p>Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>In the role of Supply Chain &amp; Manufacturing Manager, Collectibles, you will report to the Senior Manager, Global Operations.</p> <p>We are considering applicants for the location of Dallas, TX.&nbsp;</p> <p>As the Supply Chain &amp; Manufacturing Manager, Collectibles, you will be responsible for developing and leading the end-to-end global supply chain and manufacturing strategy and execution for Crunchyroll's Collectibles business. You will oversee global sourcing, supplier selection and development, manufacturing operations, production planning, inventory management, logistics, and operational readiness to ensure products are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.</p> <p>You will work cross-functionally with Product Development, Creative, Licensing, Planning, Sales, Finance, and Distribution. You will drive operational excellence through strategic supplier partnerships, scalable processes, and data-driven decision-making. By serving as the operational bridge between Product Development, Creative, Licensing, and global manufacturing partners, you will ensure innovative collectible products are successfully translated from concept into high-quality products delivered to fans worldwide. You will proactively identify operational risks, optimize cost and inventory performance, and build a resilient global supply chain that supports the continued growth of the Collectibles business.</p> <h3><strong>Core Areas of Responsibility</strong></h3> <h4><strong>Supply Chain &amp; Manufacturing Leadership</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Develop and execute global supply chain and manufacturing strategies that support product launches and long-term business growth.</li> <li>Lead end-to-end supply chain and manufacturing operations from product development through final product delivery.</li> <li>Develop production plans and manufacturing schedules aligned with product launch timelines.</li> <li>Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve operational efficiency, scalability, and overall supply chain performance.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Global Sourcing &amp; Manufacturing</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Build and manage strategic relationships with global manufacturing partners and suppliers.</li> <li>Identify, evaluate, and onboard manufacturing partners capable of supporting Crunchyroll's quality, cost, capacity, and delivery objectives.</li> <li>Lead supplier performance reviews, issue resolution, and recovery plans.</li> <li>Partner with suppliers to optimize quality, cost, lead times, manufacturing efficiency, and scalability.</li> <li>Identify and mitigate supply chain risks while ensuring operational readiness across all product launches.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Provide supply chain leadership on manufacturing feasibility, inventory strategy, production schedules, and operational risk.</li> <li>Support business planning through forecasting, KPI reporting, and data-driven decision making.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Inventory &amp; Financial Performance</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Partner with Planning and Logistics teams to optimize inventory investments while maintaining product availability.</li> <li>Manage supply chain budgets and identify opportunities to improve margins, reduce costs, and increase operational efficiency.</li> <li>Monitor key performance indicators, including supplier performance, inventory health, production schedules, cost performance, and on-time delivery.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About You</strong></h2> <p>We get excited about candidates, like you, because...</p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in supply chain, manufacturing, operations, sourcing, or product operations.</li> <li>Experience managing global suppliers and international manufacturing partners.</li> <li>Demonstrated success leading cross-functional initiatives in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Strong analytical, project management, negotiation, and communication skills.</li> <li>Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience with ERP systems.</li> <li>Experience in consumer products, collectibles, licensed merchandise, entertainment, and accessories.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience supporting global product launches and international supply chains.</li> <li>Experience with NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar ERP platforms.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing,Operations, or related field, or equivalent experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>Crunchyroll’s Global Operations team brings collectibles from concept to fans worldwide—leading global sourcing, manufacturing, production planning, inventory, logistics, and operational readiness to enable launches that meet quality, cost, and delivery goals. jd_text: Data Architect, AI and Supply Chain Insights Description - Job Summary We are seeking a Supply Chain Data Architect who combines strong data architecture expertise with a data product mindset. The role is responsible for owning and evolving a portfolio of Data Products, designing scalable and reusable data models, and ensuring data assets are trusted, governed, and optimized for reporting, analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI use cases. The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders to understand processes, priorities, and opportunities, translating them into data strategies and architecture solutions that maximize business value and adoption. A strong understanding of data engineering concepts is foundational and required, including how data is acquired, transformed, and delivered across modern data platforms. The primary focus of the role is on data architecture, data modeling, data product maturity, business engagement, and AI ready design. Success is measured by the ability to create scalable, business ready data products that enable self service analytics, advanced insights, continuously leveraging the evolving AI technologies for our Supply Chain Stakeholder. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in data architecture and modeling with business acumen, critical thinking, problem solving and a passion for innovation. They partner with business leaders, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Owners, and AI practitioners to transform complex business challenges into data driven solutions Responsibilities Own and evolve a portfolio of Supply Chain Data Products, ensuring they are certified, compliant, governed, and aligned to the latest Data Governance standards while maximizing business value and adoption. Partner with business stakeholders to understand business processes, data domains, and analytical needs, translating requirements into data strategies, architecture roadmaps, and product enhancement plans. Design and maintain scalable conceptual, logical, and physical data models, ensuring data assets are structured, documented, and optimized for reporting, analytics, AI, machine learning, and self service consumption. Drive Data Product maturity through architecture best practices, data quality, metadata management, governance, master data management, and AI ready design principles. Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Owners, and business leaders to deliver scalable data solutions, accelerate insight generation, and increase the value of enterprise data assets. Evaluate and leverage emerging technologies, AI capabilities, and modern data practices to improve business outcomes, strengthen the data ecosystem, and promote architecture excellence across the organization through mentoring and thought leadership Education & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or related field. 8+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Modeling, Data Management, Analytics, or related disciplines. Experience owning or supporting Data Products and enterprise scale data assets. Experience working directly with business stakeholders and cross functional teams. Experience supporting analytics, AI, machine learning, or data science initiatives. Experience translating business capabilities and processes into scalable data models and architectures. Required Skills Data Architecture & Data Products Data Architecture Enterprise Data Modeling (Required) Data Product Management & Lifecycle Data Governance Data Quality Master & Reference Data Management Metadata Management Data Warehousing Data Management Data Strategy Technology SQL Python Databricks Microsoft Fabric or Azure Data Services Cloud Data Platforms Data Catalog & Metadata Solutions AI & Advanced Analytics Artificial Intelligence Generative AI Machine Learning Concepts Data Science Collaboration AI Ready Data Design Analytical Thinking Business & Leadership Business Process Analysis Supply Chain Domain Knowledge Strategic Thinking Critical Thinking Problem Solving Stakeholder Management Communication and Influence Product Mindset Leadership Impact This role helps enable the current and shape the future of the Supply Chain data ecosystem by ensuring data products are trusted, governed, scalable, and optimized for business consumption, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI initiatives. Success in this role is measured not only by sound architecture, but by the ability to create highly reusable, business aligned data products that accelerate insights, enable self service analytics, and power next generation AI capabilities across the enterprise. jd_text: Excited to grow your career? We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. Compensation Grade The Power Distribution Technician uses their high voltage expertise to collaborate with engineers, planners, and other field personnel to ensure the reliable and efficient distribution of electrical power. Accountability 1: Meet all SHE objectives and comply with all governmental laws and policies while executing work in the Power Distribution area: Visibly supports and promotes the INEOS 20 Principles and the Culture of Prevention. All activities performed in accordance with established company, local, state, federal, and health safety, and environmental regulations and procedures. Ensure all maintenance activities are planned and executed in compliance with site environmental compliance requirements. Safety improvements on all pre-existing processes. Provides safe work permits to contractors working on or around high voltage equipment in the plant and maintenance buildings Verifies clear understanding of work scope, carefully reviews the type of work and potential safety or process reliability hazards. Takes appropriate action to initiate proper safety reviews (e.g., temporary job plan, confined space, hot work, etc.) when reviewing the work scope. Is aware of and responds to emergency protocols during shutdowns and startups. Accountability 2: Executing maintenance activities in support of maintaining mechanical integrity of assets and protective systems Provide information such as switching orders, or distribution process changes. Prepare switching orders that isolate work areas without causing power outages, referring to drawings of power systems. Perform maintenance, repairs, and replacements of three-phase power distribution components up to 69kV and relay hardware. Maintains and reviews maintenance records on all power distribution equipment in the plant. Ensure the reliable operation of all high voltage equipment in the plant. Performs corrective and preventative maintenance tasks on all high voltage equipment in the plant. Actively looks for electrical reliability improvement opportunities. Trouble shoots failed/underperforming equipment to identify and/or eliminate root cause. Effectively communicates at a variety of levels, including the writing of reports on equipment condition and status. Inspects and maintains overhead power distribution lines. Performs visual inspections to identify system hardware issues. Accountability 3: Supports project activities associated with the high voltage systems of the plant: Provides support to engineering project teams that install, modify, or will affect any power distribution equipment in the plant. Follows the progress of the projects ensuring that the power distribution equipment is installed correctly with all parameters being properly set for the desired operation Level of Education & Knowledge: 5+ years relevant high voltage experience (greater than 480V) in a plant, Electrical Journeyman designation, NCCER Electrical Certification or NETA certification NFPA 70E – Standard for Electrical Safety in the Workplace Working knowledge of electrical standards as applied in petrochemical industry and general knowledge of various Codes (e.g. API, ASME, ANSI, NFPA, ISA, IEEE, NETA). Working knowledge of technical documentation associated with electrical design and equipment Knowledge and experience in executing preventive maintenance plans. Experience & Technical Skills: Electrical Experience: Knowledge of and experience of troubleshooting equipment with voltages up to 69kV. Knowledge of and experience of working with high voltage substations and switchgear. Trouble-shooting skills along with the ability to read and understand P&ID, Relay Drawings, Electrical One-Lines and Loop Drawings. Knowledge of testing and maintenance of VFDs, transformers, large electric motors, UPS systems, low and high voltage switchgear, and low and medium voltage motor control centers. Safe switching practices, including creating and executing switching orders. Inspection and maintenance practices for high voltage equipment (480V to 69KV) including transformers, breakers, switches, and motors. Inspection and maintenance practices for overhead power distribution lines Adapt to changing market and customer opportunities quickly to deliver results in the most effective way.

The Supply Chain Field Materials Specialist is responsible for planning, coordinating, receiving, staging and tracking construction materials on site. Essential Functions & Responsibilities Daily Field Support Work on site daily to support Superintendents, Foremen, and self-performing trades. Understand the short-term and look-ahead work plan to anticipate material needs. Ensure materials are available, staged, and ready before crews mobilize. Act as a representative and advocate of JPI’s culture and guiding principles Maintain full-time position in the field. Comfortable working outdoors and around heavy equipment.

jd_text: FedRAMP Project Manager Description - Job Summary About the company: HP Inc. is a global technology leader pioneering innovative solutions that revolutionize the way people work and live. Our Workforce Experience software platform is at the forefront of optimizing digital experiences in the workplace, comprising multiple modules designed to enhance workforce productivity and employee engagement. About the position : As a FedRAMP Project / Program Manager, you will support the planning, coordination, and tactical execution of HP’s FedRAMP readiness effort for WXP and related managed services capabilities. This role is focused on keeping the program organized, driving follow-through across workstreams, maintaining the integrated project plan, coordinating stakeholder inputs, gathering and documenting requirements, and ensuring progress, risks, dependencies, and decisions are visible to the right owners. This role will work closely with product, engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, legal, operations, managed services, GTM, and external partner teams to help keep the FedRAMP effort moving against defined milestones. Success in this role requires strong organization, attention to detail, clear communication, follow-up discipline, and the ability to turn cross-functional inputs into actionable plans, status updates, and decision-ready summaries. Key Responsibilities: Program coordination & execution tracking Maintain the integrated FedRAMP project plan, including milestones, owners, dependencies, action items, and status updates. Own day-to-day upkeep of the FedRAMP Smartsheet / program tracker to ensure workstreams, deliverables, risks, and next steps remain current and visible. Track progress across concurrent FedRAMP workstreams spanning product, engineering, infrastructure, security, compliance, operations, and business teams. Follow up with workstream owners to drive timely completion of actions, requirements, artifacts, and open decisions. Help identify schedule risks, blockers, dependency gaps, and execution issues that require escalation. Stakeholder coordination Serve as a central coordination point across internal HP stakeholders and external partners supporting the FedRAMP effort. Schedule and support working sessions, readiness reviews, requirements reviews, and issue-resolution forums. Capture meeting notes, decisions, owners, and follow-ups, and ensure items are reflected in the program tracker. Help coordinate delivery expectations with third-party partners, including Coalfire and Amazon, as part of the broader FedRAMP execution plan. Support clear communication across product, engineering, architecture, security, legal, operations, managed services, GTM, and leadership stakeholders. Requirements intake & documentation support Gather, organize, and document FedRAMP-related requirements from product, business, security, compliance, and technical stakeholders. Help maintain requirements inventories, decision logs, artifact trackers, and dependency lists needed to support FedRAMP readiness. Coordinate inputs for key program artifacts such as architecture documentation, control readiness materials, authorization package inputs, status reports, and executive summaries. Support requirement clarification by routing questions to the right subject matter experts and tracking unresolved items to closure. Ensure requirements and action items are documented consistently and connected to relevant milestones, owners, and execution plans. Reporting & communication Prepare regular program status updates summarizing progress, risks, dependencies, blockers, and decisions needed. Support leadership and governance updates with clear, concise, executive-ready summaries. Help translate detailed project activity into clear updates that enable faster decisions and cross-functional alignment. Maintain organized program documentation so stakeholders can quickly understand status , next steps, and open issues. Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business , Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field preferred. 5-10 years of experience in project coordination, program management, product operations, technical program support, compliance program support, or a related role. Exposure to FedRAMP, DoD IL5, cloud compliance, cybersecurity, audit readiness, or authorization programs. Experience supporting technical or compliance-driven programs in partnership with engineering, security, architecture, legal, or operations teams. Experience maintaining Smartsheet dashboards, integrated project plans, milestone trackers, risk logs, or executive reporting materials. Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining clear documentation and follow-through. Strong attention to detail and comfort working with complex stakeholder maps, evolving requirements, and shifting priorities. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create concise status updates and coordinate across technical and business stakeholders. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping bring structure, visibility, and execution discipline to a complex program. jd_text: Principal Financial Analyst - Personal Systems Global Supply Chain Description - Job Summary • This role is responsible for leading and advising on critical business initiatives, overseeing analysts across finance sub-functions and geographies/organizations. The role is responsible for driving financial management by analyzing, reporting, and reconciling financial and operational results. title: Product Operations and Portfolio Program Manager
location: Spring, Texas, United States of America
jd_text: Product Operations and Portfolio Program Manager Description - HP's Personal Systems business spans PCs, displays, software, and services designed for commercial, consumer, and gaming customers worldwide. At the center of this portfolio is HP's commitment to delivering secure, manageable, and differentiated end-user experiences that scale across global enterprises, governments, and SMBs. As security threats continue to evolve, HP integrates protection across the entire Personal Systems ecosystem, from hardware and firmware to software, cloud services, and security solutions, enabling customers to confidently deploy and manage their fleets without compromising performance, usability, or resilience. HP Wolf Security is a market-leading endpoint security portfolio that combines hardware-enforced security, threat containment, endpoint management, and cloud-based services to protect customers from modern cyber threats. The portfolio spans secure PCs, firmware and BIOS protection, cloud management platforms, endpoint security solutions, and innovative security services. The Product Operations and Portfolio Program Manager provides operational leadership and business management across the HP Security GBU. This is a senior role which establishes the processes, governance, analytics, and cross-functional alignment needed to translate Security GBU strategy into measurable business and product outcomes. Operating across product management, engineering, and teams internal and external to the GBU, this role drives portfolio execution, maintains operational rigor, identifies business and delivery risks, and ensures that decisions result in clear ownership and follow-through. The role serves as a central coordination point for complex initiatives that span organizational boundaries and do not have a single functional owner. Key Responsibiliti es 1. Portfolio Governance and Roadmap Operations Establish and maintain governance processes for the Security GBU product portfolio, including roadmap reviews, prioritization, release tracking, and executive decision support. Coordinate the internal and external roadmap processes across product management, engineering, support, category, sales, and other stakeholders. Consolidate product-manager inputs into an external roadmap appropriate for broader HP audiences, facilitate periodic reviews, and route stakeholder feedback back to product owners. Identify roadmap gaps, delivery risks, missing ownership, dependencies, and items without credible release dates. Drive decisions on whether portfolio items should be completed, re-planned, escalated, removed, or moved to future planning periods. 2. Program Leadership and Operating-Model Improvement Lead complex, cross-functional programs that coordinate product management, engineering, and supporting functions. Provide direction to project leads while maintaining program-level accountability for scope, stakeholder alignment, executive communication, and results. Establish clear divisions of responsibility among program sponsors, program leadership, project managers, product managers, and functional teams. 3. Business Performance, Forecasting, and Executive Analytics Own recurring analysis of Security GBU product, revenue, shipment, attach, activation, licensing, and subscription performance. Develop and maintain consolidated operating dashboards, business-performance files, forecasts, projections, and management views. Create concise executive insights that explain performance, risks, assumptions, and recommended actions. 4. Partner, Supplier, and Contract Coordination Support operational management of strategic technology suppliers and partners when responsibilities span product, finance, legal, procurement, and business leadership. Maintain working knowledge of contractual obligations, royalty structures, licensed components, reporting requirements, and amendment needs. Coordinate the stakeholders required for supplier negotiations, contract changes, payment questions, and new partnership opportunities. 5. Go-to-Market Enablement Help Sales, WW Category, customer-success, and technical teams navigate the Security GBU portfolio, supported platforms, product configurations, and operational processes. Ensure recurring field questions and customer needs are converted into documented requirements, market requests, Jira items, roadmap decisions, or enablement content. Support customer-specific opportunities by validating product availability, configurations, dependencies, and implementation paths. Qualifications and Experience Extensive experience leading complex global programs, portfolio operations, business operations, or product operations in a matrixed technology organization. Demonstrated ability to operate across product management, engineering, finance, category, sales, supply chain, legal, and customer-success functions. Strong understanding of product-development lifecycle, portfolio governance, roadmap management, new-product introduction, and commercial operations. Advanced analytical skills, including business modeling, forecasting, trend analysis, data reconciliation, and executive insight development. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint capabilities, with experience creating management dashboards and decision-oriented presentations. Experience with Jira, SharePoint, Teams, and enterprise ordering, financial, and reporting systems. Strong program structuring, stakeholder management, risk management, written communication, negotiation, and executive-presentation skills. Ability to independently manage multiple complex workstreams with limited oversight. Technical fluency sufficient to work effectively with security-product, software, firmware, hardware, and platform-engineering teams. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; advanced business, technical, or program-management education preferred. Location & working model This position is based in Houston, Texas. Candidates should be located within a commutable distance of the Houston area. This role operates under a hybrid working arrangement, with a minimum requirement to be onsite three days per week. As a people-focused senior role, regular in-person collaboration is encouraged to support stakeholder engagement, team leadership, and business impact. The Houston site provides a collaborative workplace environment with access to meeting and conference facilities, wellness resources, fitness facilities, food services, and a range of onsite employee amenities. The location supports both in-person collaboration and hybrid working arrangements. title: Project Manager
jd_text: Job Description : Project Manager Huntsman is seeking a Project Manager supporting the Division Name Division located in Conroe, Texas . This position will report to the Capital Projects Team Lead . Job Scope We are seeking a driven and technically strong Project Manager to lead capital and expense projects at our Conroe site, supporting investments typically ranging from $200K to $10MM. This role is responsible for delivering projects following a staged gate process from Front-End Loading (FEL) through detailed design, construction, and startup. As a key member of the Capital Projects team, you will partner closely with engineering, operations, and construction to ensure projects are executed safely and delivered on time and on budget. This position requires a hands-on leader who can navigate complex project challenges and drive practical technical solutions in a dynamic plant environment. In summary, as the Project Manager, you will: Lead project development from concept through FEL, including scope definition, cost estimating, and schedule development Manage project execution through design, procurement, construction, and commissioning Coordinate cross-functional teams, including engineering, operations, maintenance, and contractors Ensure projects meet safety, quality, scope, schedule, and cost objectives Provide technical support and troubleshooting across all phases of the project Identify and resolve design, constructability, and field execution issues Support construction activities, including contractor coordination and field problem resolution Maintain project schedules, track progress, and manage changes and risks Forecast, track, and manage project costs, ensuring alignment with approved budgets Develop project justifications and support stage-gate approvals Communicate project status, risks, and key updates to stakeholders and site leadership Manage multiple projects concurrently, prioritizing activities and allocating time effectively Qualifications You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position.
