title: Senior Product Manager
jd_text: Are you looking to make an impactful difference in your work, yourself, and your community? Why settle for just a job when you can land a career? At ICW Group, we are hiring team members who are ready to use their skills, curiosity, and drive to be part of our journey as we strive to transform the insurance carrier space. We're proud to be in business for over 50 years, and its change agents like yourself that will help us continue to deliver our mission to create the best insurance experience possible. Headquartered in San Diego with regional offices located throughout the United States, ICW Group has been named for the twelfth consecutive year in a row and for the 20th time overall as a Top 50 performing P&C organization offering the stability of a large, profitable and growing company combined with a focus on all things people. It's our team members who make us an employer of choice and the vibrant company we are today. We strive to make both our internal and external communities better everyday! Learn more about why you want to be here! PURPOSE OF THE JOB The purpose of the position is to partner with key stakeholders to drive the strategic direction for a portfolio of insurance product line(s) across all distribution channels and brands. This position helps define product strategy and roadmap and champions the strategy and monitors product progression throughout the full life cycle. The position is responsible for monitoring and influencing all aspects of product performance to achieve Company revenue and performance targets. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Ideates and develops business initiatives using product knowledge and results. Leads and participates in collaborations with the head of product line underwriting unit(s) to develop product strategy and action plan to achieve growth and profit objectives. Owns inputs to bi-annual premium and exposure projections supporting financial budgeting and pro-forma processes and understand projection framework. Provides expert insights regarding profitability, retention, and growth strategies through the integration of the underwriting, marketing, policyholder services, distribution, claims, actuarial, data analytics, customer, and digital experience. Collaborates with other functional departments to coordinate timelines for delivery, maximize the effectiveness of programs, direct implementation of product strategies, and drive cross-functional alignment and engagement for initiatives supporting product objectives. Develops and maintains templates to perform competitive research and deliver competitive analyses. Utilizes and trains others in the use of internal analytical tools (spanning underwriting, marketing, customer behavior, and claims). Performs and reviews data analyses concerning loss patterns, market forces, risk distributions, and agency management to evaluate the success of current strategies to either modify or create new strategies targeting production, product pricing, underwriting, contract changes, or agency changes. Assesses the impact of changes on the in-force book, new business production, and agency force. Develops and drives initiatives for strategic product development. Applies business content knowledge in identifying priorities and executing strategic product initiatives to achieve business objectives. Monitors the marketplace to identify competitor and industry changes impacting effectiveness or compliance of current and proposed programs. Partners with Actuarial team to determine and implement appropriate pricing and program structure to achieve product goals, and design and execute product rate plan and state level enhancements across jurisdictions ensuring all changes are communicated to field services, operations, underwriting, marketing, and system technology teams. Partners with Underwriting team to facilitate changes to processes or systems, or respond to questions, and ensuring communication to affected parties. Analyzes the performance of existing products; develops and leads the creation of business cases for the development of changes to existing products or development of new products. Maintains knowledge of available internal and external data sources, including accuracy and completeness, to select the proper data set(s) for evaluation. Organizes and structures product definitions to ensure efficiencies in downstream reporting processes. Directs the implementation of underwriting guideline changes. Collaborates with strategic planning groups to incorporate enterprise class system solutions supporting the future product roadmap. Acts as product leader and subject matter expert in the maintenance of current products, filed product changes, and design and delivery of new products in development. Develops internal partnerships and collaborates with Enterprise Marketing, Legal, Compliance, Underwriting, and Actuarial Departments to manage the implementation of all ratemaking bureau rules, forms and coverage changes, and company-initiated changes including coordination with the rate filing analyst. Keeps abreast of distribution channel needs through involvement in agency facing initiatives, and regular reporting on direct to market strategies available in the industry. Possesses expert knowledge of ratemaking bureau underwriting manuals and company exception rules and maintains knowledge of any changes. Documents and memorializes changes. Researches issues or concerns around underwriting rules, including historical company filings in independent ratemaking bureaus to confirm adherence and direct changes. Maintains knowledge of rules, regulations, nuances in states of operation and engage with product line underwriting unit(s) to invoke needed changes or identify training in support of a self-sustaining culture. Proactively engages with Underwriting and Legal to ensure insurance policy provisions comply with state law. Partners with Compliance Department to identify and close any gaps in rules, respond to changes in rules, and remediate across systems, processes, reporting. Participates in regulatory approval of filings, market conduct exams, and internal responses to any state filing objections to facilitate modifications. SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES This position has no supervisory responsibilities but may mentor and train junior team members. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Bachelor's degree from a college or university required with a major or emphasis in Business, Computer Science, Math, or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience. MBA is a plus. Minimum 6 years of experience in insurance product management. Insurance industry knowledge and demonstrated work experience required. Exposure to industry recognized product management curriculum, or demonstrated experience required. Experience managing complex, large-scale, high risk product development projects preferred. KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS Extensive knowledge of insurance industry; workers compensation or commercial lines required based on role designation. Resourcefulness to research industry topics and develop proficient knowledge of internal systems and constraints to aid in managing individual state compliance. Knowledge of actuarial practice area is a plus. Highly developed quantitative analysis, decision making, and project management skills. Demonstrated ability to solve complex business problems, consistent with a deep understanding of the strategic direction of the business. Deep knowledge of the insurance product lifecycle, financial drivers of profitability, insurance regulations and general insurance operations and business processes. Ability to synthesize analytical results to guide business decisions. Strong leadership, written and oral communication, and teamwork skills required. Strong organizational skills. Ability to hold effective meetings, including setting agendas and attendees, time management, and documentation of meeting outcomes. CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter (CPCU) preferred. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit or periodically stand and work on a computer for 80-90% of time. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms and climb or balance. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 5 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. WORK ENVIRONMENT This position operates in an office environment and requires the frequent use of a computer, telephone, copier, and other standard office equipment. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. We are currently not offering employment sponsorship for this opportunity. #LI-NT1 #LI-Remote The current range for this position is $139,874.00 - $250,377.40 This range is exclusive of fringe benefits and potential bonuses. If hired at ICW Group, your final base salary compensation will be determined by factors unique to each candidate, including experience, education and the location of the role and considers employees performing substantially similar work. WHY JOIN ICW GROUP? Challenging work and the ability to make a difference You will have a voice and feel a sense of belonging We offer a competitive benefits package, with generous medical, dental, and vision plans as well as 401K retirement plans and company match Bonus potential for all positions Paid Time Off Paid holidays throughout the calendar year Want to continue learning? We’ll support you 100% ICW Group is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. ICW Group will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, age, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. ___________________ Job Category Actuarial

title: Sr. Product Manager - Clinician Workflow
jd_text: Career-defining. Life-changing. At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career About This Role: Sr. Product Manager, Digital Platform – Clinician Workflow iRhythm is looking for a Sr. Product Manager to join the digital platform product team. This role will focus on clinican-facing web portals, helping define, prioritize, and deliver workflow capabilities that support clinician-facing experiences, operational efficiency, and scalable platform growth. Over time, the role is expected to expand into broader digital platform responsibilities across clinician workflow, integrations, and adjacent platform capabilities that support iRhythm’s evolving product portfolio. You will partner closely with engineering, design, clinical, operations, commercial, regulatory, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate user needs and business priorities into high-quality software solutions that can scale across multiple products and workflows. Responsibilities include: Lead product discovery for accountable products, including voice of customer, clinician workflow research, internal stakeholder feedback, data analysis, and assessment of unmet needs and pain points. Define and maintain a prioritized roadmap, balancing clinician workflow needs, operational priorities, technical feasibility, regulatory considerations, and business impact. Translate product strategy into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release scope, and implementation plans that align business value, technical feasibility, regulatory considerations, and user experience. Partner with program/project management to lead cross-functional core teams through product development, launch readiness, change management, and post-launch adoption. Work closely with engineering, design, UX, clinical operations, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality features and intuitive workflows through iterative development. Measure, analyze, and communicate product performance, adoption, operational impact, and KPI trends to inform roadmap decisions and demonstrate outcomes. Willing to travel up to 20%. About you: You care deeply about building healthcare technology that improves workflows, supports clinicians, and enables better patient and customer outcomes. The end user is always your first priority, and you seek to understand day-to-day pain points through data, research, workflow observation, and direct stakeholder engagement. You know enough about software delivery, systems, and integrations to partner effectively with technical teams and can communicate complex ideas at the right level for executives, engineers, operators, and clinical stakeholders. You bring structure to ambiguity, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and communicate your rationale clearly so teams stay aligned and moving forward. Desired Qualifications 5+ years of product management experience, ideally with software platforms, workflow applications, or digital health products. Experience in healthcare IT, medical device, digital health, clinical workflow, or regulated software environments. Strong ability to define product scope, write clear requirements, prioritize effectively, and guide teams through ambiguity. Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills. Deep knowledge of product management best practices, including discovery, roadmap planning, agile delivery, launch readiness, and outcome measurement. Strong end-user orientation, with experience gathering feedback from both internal and external users and translating insights into product decisions. Experience using analytics, business intelligence, or product data to monitor adoption, workflow performance, and business impact. Strong systems analysis, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving skills. Demonstrates initiative as a self-starter; results oriented, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment. Experience with Atlassian tools such as Jira and Confluence, road mapping tools such as Aha!, and analytics tools such as Tableau, Pendo, Google Analytics, or SQL. BA/BS in science, engineering, business, healthcare, or a technical field. Advanced degree or MBA desired. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or improving applications that support multiple end-user personas and complex workflow handoffs. Experience with clinician-facing software, care team workflows, reporting tools, patient monitoring platforms, or healthcare operations platforms. Familiarity with EHR integrations, interoperability concepts, customer care systems, user management tools, or revenue cycle management workflows. Experience with requirements management applications such as Jama or DOORS and design control applications such as MasterControl. Technical fluency with software architecture, APIs, data flows, scripting, or object-oriented development concepts. Experience leading cross-functional teams in a remote or distributed work environment. Location: Remote - US Actual compensation may vary depending on job-related factors including knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. Estimated Pay Range $127,000.00 - $165,000.00 As a part of our core values, we ensure an inclusive workforce. We welcome and celebrate people of all backgrounds, experiences, skills, and perspectives. iRhythm Technologies, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Combining wearable biosensors and cloud-based data analytics with powerful proprietary algorithms, iRhythm distills data from millions of heartbeats into clinically actionable information. Through a relentless focus on patient care, iRhythm’s vision is to deliver better data, better insights, and better health for all. Make iRhythm your path forward. jd_text: JAS is an international, non-asset-based supply chain services and solutions company. Our services include air and ocean freight forwarding, contract logistics, customs brokerage, distribution, inbound logistics, truckload brokerage and other supply chain management services, including consulting, the coordination of purchase orders and customized management services. SUMMARY: The Project Manager is responsible for overseeing project logistics operations, managing subcontractor and vendor relationships, and driving business growth across the assigned market. This role ensures operational excellence, regulatory and QHSSE compliance, financial performance, and high levels of client satisfaction while identifying and securing new business opportunities. The position works closely with clients, internal teams, carriers, and subcontractors to successfully manage complex project shipments, develop strategic relationships, and continuously improve service delivery and profitability. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Sub-Contractors / Vendors To identify potential sub-contractor / vendor to support our capabilities. To conduct due diligence to all sub- contractor / vendor to ensure compliance. To establish and maintaining good relationship with sub-contractor / vendor for better negotiation and quality of work. To ensure JAS procedures and guidelines are followed at all times including QHSSE, Transport Engineering, Ethical / Process Compliance. Client service levels, maintaining first in class operational and administrative procedures at all times ensuring high levels of client satisfaction Recruitment of staff, personal development and welfare ensuring long term staff retention Managing HR & disciplinary matters in conjunction with JAS HR Departments If instructed to do so sourcing and implementing new JP facilities throughout SEA Business Development Carry out aggressive and extensive business development with first, second and third tier clients within your Country, growing JP revenue and GP. Travelling is needed as and when it requires . Working closely with Business Development Manager – S.E. Asia. To attend regular face to face meeting with Clients maintaining & growing relationship. To upload Wintouch Report after every meeting with Clients. To share sales lead with JAS’s oversea offices to widen our network. Contractual & Financial Management of Project Business: Managing / monitoring financial forecasts, monitoring and managing account receivables and payables. KPI & Milestone management, work closely with Operation to ensure laid down Cargowise processes are followed by all staff. Implementing and amending specific localized documents & procedures such as Standard Operating Procedures as required . Monitoring and reporting on: Ethical Conduct & Due Diligence, Transport Engineering requirements, Quality, Health and Safety, Environment including developing any required localized procedures Negotiating with Carriers to obtain the best possible buying rates and favorable contractual terms on behalf of JP SEA. Risk Management, Insurance Claim management. Country responses to pre-qualification requests, RFI, RFQ for clients Liaison with JAS financial on cash flow forecasts, AR& AP and day to day HR business. Management of JP Sub-Contractors: Ethical Conduct & Due Diligence (ECDD), Quality, Health and Safety, Environment procedures. Financial (including timely and accurate billing in liaison with Ops Vietnam) Service levels. Processing of new Sub-Contractors through the JAS Vendor Approval Process. Ensuring Sub-Contractors maintain validity of ECDD training and insurances and maintaining such records in conjunction with JAS ATL Administrative Supervisor. Identify new suitable Sub-Contractors. Overall responsibility for all day-to-day operational aspects of the business. Monitoring high profile “HOTSHOT” shipment progress in conjunction with Ops team . Chartering aircraft and vessels by following relevant SOPs. Supervise subsequent loading and discharging operations in support of ops as/when required and raise subsequent client reports. Liaison with JP transport engineering for out-of-gauge heavy lift shipments. Constantly seek out and develop ways to improve the operational service received by JP clients, whilst increasing profit margins on JP business. QUALIFICATIONS: Excellent organizational skills Excellent written and verbal skills Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills Thorough knowledge of transportation industry , logistics and freight forwarding Thorough knowledge of related business development & sales functions Thorough knowledge of successful project management Strong computer skills including Microsoft Office suite Detail oriented, able to multitask and meet deadlines Self-motivated, able to work in a team and independently Must have valid driver’s license and safe driving record EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Bachelor’s degree/ Diploma or equivalent pr eferred At least 5 years or more successful projects & business development experience in Projects, F reight forwarding , L ogistics and / or the T ransportation industry The responsibilities associated with this job will change from time to time in accordance with the Company’s business needs. title: Lead, Operations Strategy - Specialty Services Implementation
jd_text: At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare. Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team! LifeStance Health Values Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self. Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment. Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it. One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose. Benefits As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program. ROLE OVERVIEW As a Lead, Operations Strategy - Specialty Services Implementation, you will play an integral role in developing and implementing new service lines that improve the experience of LifeStance clinicians and patients across the country and further the mission of the organization. In this role, you will be a catalyst for change, driving growth, business process improvement, and initiatives aimed at growing LifeStance’s business offerings. As a member of the Ops Strategy - Specialty Services Team, you will leverage your expertise to lead and influence stakeholders, ensuring the seamless execution of national initiatives. You will work cross-functionally with all corporate teams, including Technology, People, Finance, Clinical Leadership & Shared Services to lead teams toward solving complex problems. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to build relationships with Operations leaders across the business to understand their needs and develop initiatives that allow them to better service patients across the geographies they lead. Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description. KEY RESPONSIBILITES Drive the implementation of new service lines through a combination of direct involvement, partnership with the local operating team, and influence over internal stakeholder partners (shared services, corporate support, etc.). Execute, document and optimize on a scalable, repeatable playbook for launching new national programs at the site level. Provide subject matter expertise to all internal partners to ensure successful implementation and ongoing support of local Specialty Services programs. Collaborate with management to understand Specialty Services training needs and identify areas for improvement. Accountable for reporting standard key performance indicators, performance root causes, and action plans for improvement to management. Assess and analyze current business practices and procedures, identifying weaknesses and opportunities for enhancement. Develop comprehensive cross-functional project plans to drive changes and improvements in service line launches and performance. Lead the development of training content in various forms (live meetings, asynchronous Workday trainings, etc.) Organize and manage Specialty Services projects, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives. Liaise between departments to ensure effective communication related to Specialty Services initiatives. REQUIREMENTS Required Skills/Abilities: Microsoft Office experience; Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, etc.), PowerPoint presentation skills. Strong stakeholder management and influence skills, with the ability to align diverse perspectives, drive consensus, and facilitate decision-making in complex environments. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to handle sensitive and confidential information. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and synthesize new information, becoming a subject matter expert to drive informed decision-making and strategic insights. Highly organized with strong attention to detail and accuracy. Familiarity with project management software and applications is a plus. Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States LifeStance is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture. Education and Experience: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience required 3+ years of healthcare experience required, with at least 1 year of healthcare leadership or management experience preferred. Experience at a high-growth company, a plus. Demonstrated experience collaborating with clinical and operational teams to design and implement programs that enhance clinical workflows and support patient care initiatives. Proven track record in managing EHR systems, billing, coding, and compliance processes to streamline operations. Key Behaviors: Behave Ethically: Understand ethical behavior and business practices and ensure own behavior and the behavior of others are consistent with these standards and align with the values of the company. Focus on Stakeholder Needs: Anticipate, understand, and respond to the needs of key stakeholders to meet or exceed their expectations within the organization’s parameters. Build Relationships: Establish and maintain positive working relationships with others both internally and externally to achieve the goals of the organization. Communicate Effectively: Speak, listen, and write in a clear, thorough, and timely manner using appropriate and effective communication tools and techniques. Foster Teamwork: Work cooperatively and effectively with across teams to set goals, resolve problems and make decisions that enhance organizational effectiveness. Make Decisions: Assess situations to determine the importance, urgency, and risks, and make clear decisions which are timely and in the best interests of the organization. Organization: Set priorities, develop a work schedule, and monitor progress towards goals, and track details, data, information, & activities. Solve Problems: Assess problem situations to identify causes, gather and process relevant information, generate possible solutions, and make recommendations and/or resolve the problem. Flexibility and Adaptability: Willingness to be flexible in responsibilities and duties and easily adapt to the needs of the company. Attention to Detail and Accuracy: Understands the need for accurate information in data analysis and communication with internal teams and stakeholders. Appreciation for Diverse Backgrounds & Thought: Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS Remote; flexibility to travel up to 10% of time to support projects or initiatives onsite at LifeStance practice locations or to attend team meetings. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus. COMPENSATION: $90,000 - $100,000/annually LifeStance provides the compensation range and benefits that it in good faith believes it might pay and/or offer for this position. LifeStance reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, or federal law. #LI-TS1 LifeStance is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are fully committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all our employees. Learn more about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at LifeStance. LifeStance Health complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact our Human Resources Team at ADA@lifestance.com . Please note: This contact is intended solely for accommodation requests. Inquiries regarding applications, resumes and applicant status should not be sent to this email address as they will not be reviewed or responded to. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About Crunchyroll</h2> <p>Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.</p> <p>Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!</p></div><p>As a Principal Technical Program Manager in Enterprise Technology, you will lead the delivery of our largest technology initiatives: enterprise system implementations, migrations and integration programs that cut across engineering teams, business functions and external partners. You are as comfortable in a design review as in a steering committee: you understand systems well enough to see delivery risk, and you explain it in terms the business can understand and act on.</p> <p>This is a senior individual contributor role. As the business grows, so does the number of programs running at once, and leaders need one person who can tell them what is on track, what is at risk and where a decision is needed. You will also set the standard for how technical program management works in Enterprise Technology. AI tools are part of how we plan and communicate; you are expected to use them.</p> <p>We are considering applicants for the Dallas location (in-office Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays).</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <ul> <li>Lead large, complex technical programs across engineering, product, business functions, and external partners, from plan to launch.</li> <li>Build and maintain integrated program plan: milestones, dependencies, and the critical path across every team and system involved.</li> <li>Keep one reliable view of program health that leaders can read at any time.</li> <li>Surface technical and cross-team risks early.</li> <li>Own the release and change calendar for Enterprise Technology systems and the cutover coordination for major launches: freeze windows, readiness criteria, go/no-go, and the rollback decision path.</li> <li>Run the program cadence: planning, dependency reviews, risk and decision tracking, retrospectives.</li> <li>Set the practices for technical program management across Enterprise Technology: what counts as a program, how plans and risks are managed, and how delivery stays visible as the portfolio grows.</li> </ul> <h2>About You</h2> <p>We get excited about candidates, like you, because...</p> <ul> <li>You have 15+ years of experience leading complex technical programs, with at least 3 at senior or principal scope.</li> <li>You have Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.</li> <li>You have prior experience as an engineer, systems analyst, technical lead or equivalent hands-on role before moving into program delivery.</li> <li>You have led at least one major enterprise system implementation or migration from planning through cutover, including the technical cutover.</li> <li>You can read and question technical artifacts directly: integration designs, data-migration plans, release plans, test results.</li> <li>You are an expert in program planning, critical path and dependency management, and release readiness.</li> <li>You have sound judgment on when to decide, when to consult and when to escalate.</li> <li>You can turn a complex program into a concise, decision oriented update.</li> <li>You are hands-on with AI-assisted tools in program work, and willing to implement new capabilities into planning, analysis and documentation.</li> <li>You influence senior stakeholders and engineering teams across a globally distributed organization, with planned overlap across time zones.</li> </ul> <h3>A plus if you have experience with:</h3> <ul> <li>Programs involving financial systems, business applications or digital media workflows.</li> <li>Compliance sensitive or audit controlled environments.</li> <li>Programs with external vendors or implementation partners.</li> </ul> <h2>Why you will love working at Crunchyroll</h2> <p>In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:</p> <ul> <li>Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.</li> <li>Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.</li> <li>Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance</li> <li>Health Saving Account HSA program</li> <li>Health care and dependent care FSA</li> <li>401(k) plan, with employer match</li> <li>Employer paid commuter benefit</li> <li>Support program for new parents</li> <li>Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!</li> </ul> <p>#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About our Values</h3> <p>We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value</p> <ul> <li> <p>Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.</p> </li> <li> <p>Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.</p> </li> <li>Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.</li> <li> <p>Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Our commitment to diversity and inclusion</h3> <p>Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity &amp; inclusion. It's just the way we do business.</p> <p>We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.</p> <p>Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Questions about Crunchyroll’s hiring process? You will go beyond reporting to investigate what happened, why it happened, what we should do about it, and where we should invest to drive meaningful improvements in engagement. You will analyze consumer behavior to develop insights and strategies that help users discover more relevant content, establish strong viewing habits, and ultimately improve retention.</p> <p>This habit formation.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About You</strong></h2> <p>We get excited about candidates, like you, because...</p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in analytics, strategy, data science, jd_text: Business Planning Manager Description - The Strategic Business Manager serves as a trusted advisor and operational leader to the Director of Inventory Planning, driving strategic execution, organizational effectiveness, business transformation, and cross-functional alignment across a global supply chain planning organization. This role is significantly broader than traditional business management and requires a highly strategic operator who can translate executive vision into measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate combines executive presence, business acumen, supply chain knowledge, analytical rigor, and organizational leadership to enable a best-in-class planning organization operating in a highly dynamic and supply-constrained environment. The role acts as the connective tissue across Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, Commodity Planning, Finance, Procurement, Sales Operations, IT/Digital, and Manufacturing partners to ensure alignment between operational execution, financial objectives, and long-term transformation goals. This individual will lead strategic planning rhythms, executive communications, organizational governance, digital transformation coordination, KPI management, operating model development, and executive-level business reviews while driving accountability and operational excellence across the organization. Responsibilities Strategic Leadership & Executive Partnership Serve as strategic advisor and Chief of Staff to the Sr. Director of Supply Planning, helping define organizational priorities, operating models, and long-term transformation strategy. Drive execution of the organization’s strategic roadmap, ensuring alignment between business objectives, financial goals, operational plans, and digital transformation initiatives. Lead executive-level preparation for business reviews, QBRs, operating reviews, SIOP governance, financial reviews, and leadership communications. Translate complex operational and supply chain topics into concise executive-ready insights, recommendations, and decision frameworks. Drive organizational prioritization, escalation management, and cross-functional alignment in highly dynamic business environments. Supply Chain & Business Operations Partner across Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, Procurement, Finance, Sales Operations, and Manufacturing teams to improve planning effectiveness, inventory optimization, service attainment, and execution discipline. Support the transition from traditional demand-driven planning processes toward more supply-driven and scenario-based planning capabilities. Lead business cadence management including staff meetings, KPI reviews, strategic initiatives, organizational action tracking, and operational follow-through. Identify operational risks, process gaps, and execution barriers while driving mitigation plans and executive visibility. Financial & Business Acumen Support financial alignment across inventory, E&O, cost optimization, service attainment, and operational investment strategies. Develop executive-level business cases, scenario modeling, financial analysis, and strategic recommendations for leadership decision-making. Partner with Finance and Supply Chain leadership to improve visibility into operational performance drivers and financial implications. Drive organizational KPI frameworks with clear accountability, performance measurement, and operational transparency. Organizational Effectiveness & Leadership Improve organizational operating rhythm. communication flow, accountability, structures, and decision-making effectiveness Lead cross-functional initiatives involving senior leadership stakeholders across multiple business organizations. Mentor teams and influence leaders across all organizational levels without direct authority. Foster a culture of collaboration, simplification, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. title: IT Infrastructure Specialist, Cloud Platform
jd_text: Who We Are International Justice Mission (IJM) is the global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,300 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable. We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve . The Need For over 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking a n IT Infrastructure Specialist, Cloud Platform to support and operate our cloud platform. This role focuses on the operational excellence, reliability, security, and performance of IJM’s Microsoft Azure environment, while also contributing to automation, standardization, and continuous platform improvement. The Cloud Platform Specialist is a hands-on technical role within IT Operations, partnering closely with Architecture, Engineering, Security, and Compliance teams to ensure Azure services effectively support IJM’s mission . This position is hybrid (onsite Tuesdays & Thursdays) if located in the Washington, DC area or remote for non-local candidates. It reports to the Solutions Architect, IT Operations and is only available for candidates with the right to work in the US. Responsibilities: Cloud Platform Operations Own the operational health, availability, and performance of Azure environments across multiple subscriptions and workloads; Manage and support Azure services across computer , networking, storage, identity, and platform services; Monitor workloads using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights, ensuring actionable alerting and timely response; Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident remediation activities; Perform platform maintenance, upgrades, security remediation, and configuration changes; Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure Azure environments meet organizational and regulatory requirements; Support cost visibility and optimization efforts using Azure-native tools and reporting; Platform Engineering & Automation Implement and maintain Azure infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code ( IaC ), with a strong preference for Bicep or equivalent tools; Maintain standardized Azure deployments aligned to best practices for naming, tagging, diagnostics, and security baselines; Support Azure governance capabilities including management groups, Azure Policy, role-based access control (RBAC), and subscription structure; Automate operational tasks and workflows using PowerShell (7+), Azure CLI, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions); Collaborate with application and DevOps teams to support secure and scalable Azure solutions; Networking & Partnership Business Consultation: In partnership with IT Solutions Architect, engage with business and IT partners across all levels and roles to understand their needs and map onto the appropriate Azure services; and make recommendations to improve existing services; IT Team Collaboration: Participation in IT team Huddles, All Hands, and other collaborative working sessions, to ensure alignment with the technology team and to foster communication, planning and coordination. Cross-train other IT Operations team members to serve as operational alternates. Act as an operational alternate for other IT Operations team members where needed; Documentation, Reporting & Data Management Documentation: Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, and platform standards; Performance Metrics & Reporting: Monitor and report on platform operational metrics monthly and quarterly to ensure platform and workload SLO’s are being met; Stable, secure, and observable Azure environments supporting business and mission needs; Consistent, standardized platform configurations aligned to organizational and industry best practices; Increased operational efficiency through automation and improved tooling; Continuing improvements in platform design and operations to meet Microsoft’s Azure Well-Architected Framework guidelines while aligning with business needs; Effective incident response resulting in reduced recurrence and improved platform resilience; and Participation in IJM’s community of spiritual formation . Qualifications: 5+ years of experience in infrastructure, cloud, or systems engineering roles; 3+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure experience in production environments; Demonstrated experience supporting and operating cloud platforms in an enterprise environment; Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent experience will be considered; Microsoft Azure certifications (Administrator, Solutions Architect, or similar) preferred; Strong experience with Microsoft Azure IaaS and PaaS services; Experience implementing or maintaining Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM, or Terraform); Scripting and automation using PowerShell and/or Azure CLI; Solid understanding of Azure identity, networking, and security fundamentals; Familiarity with Azure Policy, RBAC, and governance models; Fluency with the Azure Well-Architected Framework ; and Mature orthodox Christian faith as defined by the Apostles' Creed. Critical Qualities: Eager commitment to IJM's Core Values: Christian, Professional, and Bridge-Building; Self-starter with strong initiative and accountability; Disciplined with priorities; Strong interpersonal skills and self-awareness; Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; Flexible, collaborative, and eager to support others; Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; Ability to operate effectively in a production, service-oriented environment; Experience working in global, multicultural organizations; Effective team player who fosters a collaborative environment; and Adept at creative problem-solving. Application Process: Upload Resume, Cover Letter & Statement of Faith* in one PDF document . *What is a statement of faith? A statement of faith should describe your Christian faith and how you see it as relevant to your involvement with IJM. The statement can either be incorporated into the cover letter or submitted as a separate document and should include, at a minimum, a description of your spiritual disciplines (prayer, study, etc.) and your current fellowship or place of worship. What does IJM have to offer? Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision benefits Monthly commuter and parking benefits in the DC metro area Retirement benefit options Paid leave starting at 23 days 12 holidays (plus early release the day prior) Daily, quarterly, and annual community spiritual formation Robust staff care resources IJM holds strict safeguarding principles and a zero tolerance to violations of the Safeguarding Policy, Protection against Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment Policy, and Code of Ethics. Candidate selection is based on technical competence, recruitment, selection and hiring criteria subject to assessing the candidates value congruence and thorough background, police clearance, and reference check processes. At IJM, we’re committed to building a diverse workforce through fair and equitable employment practices. IJM encourages people of any race, color, age, sex, marital status or political ideology to apply for employment. While we welcome everyone into this work, we truly believe that the work we are doing is God’s work, not our own, and practice spiritual disciplines together daily. That’s why we legally require under SEC. 2000e-1 [Section702] of Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 that all employees practice a mature orthodox Christian faith, as defined by the Apostles’ Creed. IJM requires a background check, police clearance and thorough review of references with an employment offer and/or employment contract.

Customer We focus on our customers’ success Innovation We create better solutions Collaboration We create success together Inclusion We always interact with others respectfully Candor We are open and honest with one another Integrity We do the right things and do things right &#xa; Accountabilities & Responsibilities : Strategy, Roadmap & Value Acceleration Partner with Global Quality Systems leadership to define QMS technology strategy, annual priorities, roadmaps, and measurable objectives. title: Technology Applications Specialist
jd_text: Technology Applications Specialist Help shape the technology that supports the delivery of exceptional radiology services. About the Role IDX is seeking an experienced Technology Applications Specialist to join our team and provide specialist expertise across our clinical applications environment. Reporting to the Technology Applications – Operations Manager, you will play a key role in the administration, configuration, testing and ongoing support of our radiology applications. Working closely with radiologists, application vendors, IT teams and other internal stakeholders, you'll help ensure our systems and workflows operate effectively and continue to meet the needs of the business. This is a fast-paced, hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys solving problems, building strong stakeholder relationships and using technology to improve clinical workflows. You'll bring your knowledge of PACS and radiology environments to help us optimise existing applications, support integrations and identify opportunities for continuous improvement as we continue to evolve the way radiology services are delivered. What You'll Be Doing In this role, you will: Work with stakeholders to identify, analyse and implement opportunities for improvement Provide clinical applications expertise, configuration, testing and ongoing application support Troubleshoot and resolve technical, workflow and application issues Assist with Radiologist onboarding, training sessions and demo’s for staff Deliver timely and high-quality support and resolutions for all incidents and service requests recorded in the IT Service Management (ITSM) platform. Monitor application performance and help maintain reliable clinical workflows Liaise with application vendors to resolve issues and ensure quality service delivery Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, radiologists and operational stakeholders Assist with maintaining, testing and validating radiology applications Support effective workflows and continuous improvement, with the creation of user guides and multimedia resources About You We're looking for a collaborative and solutions-focused professional who combines strong technical capability with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ideally, you'll bring: Demonstrated Radiology Applications experience and knowledge Previous experience working within a radiology environment , either in the private or public sector A strong understanding of radiology workflows and the interaction between RIS, PACS and HL7 Experience supporting, maintaining, monitoring, testing and validating clinical or radiology applications Experience working with Microsoft technologies and products Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills Experience in customer relationship management, project management and/or quality assurance Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment Proven experience providing high-quality support to end users across different levels of an organisation The ability to communicate confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders, vendors and clinical teams Why Join IDX? You'll work with a diverse group of clinical, operational and technology professionals, have exposure to business-critical applications and contribute to improvements in the technology and workflows that underpin the delivery of radiology services. If you're an experienced PACS professional who enjoys solving complex problems, improving clinical workflows and working closely with stakeholders, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to join IDX and help us continue to transform the way radiology is delivered. Integral Diagnostics (IDX Group) supports a multicultural and diversity workplace. We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians with relevant skills and experience to apply. Building a healthier world, by delivering the best health outcomes one patient at a time.

title: Enterprise Risk Management Analyst
jd_text: This position may work remotely from any of the following countries: Bangladesh, Bolivia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Cote d’Ivoire, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Kenya/Alliance locations, Malawi, Mexico, Mozambique, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, South Africa, the United Kingdom, and Zambia. Compensation for this position will be determined on the prevailing market rate in the employee's country and the applicable statutory laws, in addition to Ipas's own pay philosophy and other factors, such as the employee's experience level and expertise. The Ipas Network Risk Service Node is responsible for supporting and providing resources in the areas of risk management, safety and security, internal audit, and ethics. The Enterprise Risk Management Analyst plays a critical role in strengthening organizational resilience and accountability for Ipas in these areas. This position provides technical and operational support to the Network Risk function, which oversees enterprise risk management (ERM), safety and security, insurance and risk pooling arrangements, internal audit coordination and ethics. The Enterprise Risk Management Analyst identifies and manages threats to an organization's strategic mission, staff safety, and programmatic impact, especially in areas where complex and/or evolving legal, political, and operational landscapes create higher risk for the organization. Risk Identification & Assessment Conduct risk assessments considering political, regulatory, financial, and reputational factors in global operations. Identify knowledge gaps among staff and partners on risk, reporting, and organizational accountability Develop tracking mechanisms to ensure compliance with policies across all offices. Provide analysis and recommendations to inform risk mitigation plans across country offices and global teams. Support teams by collaborating with local HR and Risk contact to coordinate resources such as EAP crisis management when facing adverse safety and/or security concerns. Capacity Building & Awareness Deliver trainings during onboarding, refresher cycles, and targeted learning sessions tailored to diverse audiences and local context. Collaborate with HR, Procurement, IT, and Communications teams to integrate risk and accountability into organizational systems. Other duties as assigned. Minimum Bachelor's degree in risk management, Finance, International Development, Public Health, or related field. 5+ years’ experience in enterprise risk management, compliance, or internal audit, ideally within NGOs or donor-funded projects. Proven experience creating and leading training programs Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent verbal, auditory, and written communication and stakeholder engagement abilities across diverse cultural contexts and various levels of the organization. title: Sr. Specialist, IT Procurement (Software & Technology)
jd_text: Title: Sr. Specialist, IT Procurement (Software & Technology) The Sr. Specialist, IT Procurement is responsible for leading the strategic sourcing, procurement, negotiation, and supplier management of enterprise software, SaaS applications, cloud services, technology platforms, cybersecurity solutions, and other IT-related products and services. This position serves as a trusted advisor to Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Finance, Legal, Enterprise Architecture, Digital Transformation, and business stakeholders to ensure technology investments deliver maximum commercial value while minimizing financial, contractual, operational, and compliance risks. The role requires deep expertise in software licensing models, SaaS agreements, cloud consumption contracts, maintenance and support renewals, subscription-based services, and technology supplier negotiations. The individual will manage complex sourcing initiatives from initial business requirements through contract execution and ongoing supplier relationship management. Working with limited supervision, the Sr. Specialist applies advanced procurement knowledge, commercial acumen, analytical expertise, and negotiation skills to optimize spend, improve supplier performance, support technology transformation initiatives, and ensure alignment with corporate procurement and governance requirements. The position also provides mentorship, guidance, and quality oversight to procurement specialists and junior sourcing professionals while supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the procurement organization. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Sourcing & Category Management Lead strategic sourcing and category management initiatives for enterprise software, SaaS, cloud services, cybersecurity, hardware, telecommunications, technology consulting, and related IT categories. Develop sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives and technology roadmaps; conduct market intelligence, benchmarking, supplier evaluations, and competitive RFI/RFQ/RFP processes. Evaluate supplier offerings, commercial models, and licensing structures to identify best-value solutions and cost optimization opportunities. Software & Cloud Licensing Management Negotiate software licensing, SaaS subscriptions, cloud consumption, maintenance and support renewals, and technology services agreements. Manage commercial relationships with major technology providers, including Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, AWS, Google Cloud, Salesforce, Broadcom, Adobe, ServiceNow, Workday, and engineering software providers such as Ansys, Autodesk, Bentley, Aveva, and AspenTech. Evaluate licensing structures, usage rights, subscription models, user metrics, consumption-based pricing, and contractual commitments. Partner with Software Asset Management, IT, and Finance to optimize license utilization, reduce redundant spend, consolidate suppliers, and support license compliance. Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management Lead complex negotiations covering pricing, discounts, volume incentives, service levels, renewal protections, benchmarking, price increases, audit rights, intellectual property, data ownership, liability, termination, and other commercial terms. Collaborate with Legal, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Risk, Finance, and business stakeholders to assess contractual risk and ensure agreements meet business, regulatory, security, and operational requirements. Supplier Relationship Management Manage strategic technology supplier relationships and serve as the primary procurement contact for assigned suppliers. Conduct supplier performance and business reviews; resolve disputes, service issues, invoicing discrepancies, licensing concerns, and delivery failures. Negotiate corrective actions, service credits, refunds, remediation plans, and performance improvements while driving continuous supplier improvement. Stakeholder Engagement & Business Partnership Partner with IT leadership, project managers, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, Finance, and business stakeholders throughout the technology acquisition lifecycle. Lead requirements gathering, market analysis, sourcing strategy, supplier selection, negotiations, and contract execution. Translate business requirements into effective sourcing and contracting strategies and support technology budgeting, forecasting, and investment planning. Procurement Governance & Compliance Ensure compliance with procurement policies, delegated authority, financial controls, cybersecurity standards, regulatory requirements, and contractual obligations. Maintain accurate procurement and contract documentation and support internal and external audits. Ensure suppliers meet security, insurance, contractual, and policy requirements while promoting procurement best practices and process standardization. Analytics & Continuous Improvement Analyze technology spending and identify cost reduction, efficiency, and process improvement opportunities. Support procurement technology, workflow automation, sourcing tools, and digital transformation initiatives. Recommend improvements that enhance efficiency, controls, stakeholder experience, and business value. Leadership & Mentorship Mentor procurement specialists and less experienced sourcing professionals and provide quality oversight of sourcing activities, commercial analyses, contract documentation, and negotiations. Share best practices, support professional development, and serve as a subject matter expert in IT procurement and software licensing. Required Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Experience in lieu of a degree will also be considered. Minimum 5-8 years of progressive experience in IT procurement, strategic sourcing, contract negotiation, software licensing, or supplier management. Demonstrated experience negotiating enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, cybersecurity, engineering software, and technology services agreements. Experience managing strategic supplier relationships and complex commercial negotiations. Strong understanding of software licensing models, subscription-based services, cloud consumption agreements, and technology procurement practices. Experience supporting cross-functional teams and enterprise technology initiatives. Preferred Qualifications 8+ years of technology sourcing and procurement experience. Experience supporting large global organizations and multi-business-unit environments. Experience with software asset management (SAM), cloud financial management (FinOps), or IT vendor management programs. Knowledge of enterprise procurement and ERP platforms such as Deltek, SAP, Oracle, Ariba, Coupa, ServiceNow, or similar systems. Professional certifications such as CPSM, CPSD, CPM, CSCP, ITAM, SAM, FinOps Certified Practitioner, or equivalent. Experience negotiating agreements with major technology suppliers such as Microsoft, Oracle, AWS, Google Cloud, Salesforce, Broadcom, Adobe, ServiceNow, Workday, IBM, and engineering software providers including Ansys, Autodesk, Bentley, Aveva, and AspenTech. title: Logistics Specialist - Site (ICE Transport)
jd_text: Title: Logistics Specialist Location: El Paso, TX Schedule: This position is mission critical and essential to the ongoing operations and requires a flexible schedule to support a 24/7/365-day operation. About MVM, Inc. Service, Support, Success are the pillars upon which MVM’s founders built the company, and they continue to serve as MVM’s core values. Along with our uncompromising insistence on integrity and ethical business practices, these values make us the service provider of choice for our customers and the employer of choice for our dedicated team members. Working at MVM, Inc. takes a certain kind of person; we want someone who identifies with our values and is willing to challenge themselves both personally and professionally. We seek employees who are passionate about serving and making a difference in the lives of others. If you can envision joining a team where you will have the opportunity to provide mission driven results; then we are looking for you! Job Summary: The Logistics Specialist (LS) supports 24/7 operations and performs operational, logistical support, and administrative tasks required to support ground and air transportation. The Logistics Specialist works in conjunction with field staff and site leadership, Command Center, corporate logistics department, and stakeholders to coordinate the safe transport of minors and/or families and staff. He/she manages daily operations for inventory, supplies, distribution, facilities, and transportation for the site assigned. The Logistics Specialist conducts vehicle safety, including regular preventative and corrective vehicle maintenance, and ensures drivers are authorized to operate vehicles. Essential Functions and Responsibilities: Follows company and contract policies, procedures, and guidance. Prepares, reviews, and coordinates the documentation, personal property and special accommodations required for transportation of all minors and ensures all paperwork is provided for proper transport for reunification or transfer to shelter. Assists with transfer of custody and property for small and/or large groups. Keeps in constant communication with transport teams assuming custody of minors and/or family units, to include checking status of vehicles in route. Informs Command Center and Site leadership of any transport cancellations. Inventories, orders, and delivers meals, supplies, electronics, and/or clothing; prepares backpacks with essentials including tablet and mobile phone for trips. Drives passengers to and from client sites and/or airports. Installs/removes child car and booster seats based on age and height/weight, as required. Observes and assists with UC and/or family unit orientation, answers questions, and describes the transport process. Assists in charter flights/buses preparations, to include reviewing documentation, inspecting bathrooms for cleanliness to ensure high standard of quality, and driving to flightline. Cleans vehicles, sanitizes interiors, and ensures they are fueled and ready for ground trips. Checks vehicles for contraband and ensure coolers and emergency kits are in vehicles. Updates information in the company’s database systems (e.g., Canvas, Verizon Connect, Pantry, fleet system, etc.) and prepares transportation, equipment, inventory, and meal reports as well as Ad Hoc reports as required. Assists in tracking, and monitoring logistics specific training (e.g., DOT, inventory, fleet, facilities, etc.) and assists with logistics projects as needed. Assists management staff with cost benefit estimates as directed by supervisor. Monitors and reports DOT compliance, camera surveillance and GPS tracking, driver IDs (e.g., key fobs), and Hours of Service information for compliance purposes and elevates concerns to supervisor and Site Manager. Follows company quality control and inspection plans and executes the company’s Fleet Management program, including Preventive Maintenance (PM), mileage tracking, registration, tolls, inspections, logs, etc., as required. Tracks inventory and supplies; monitors availability of stock; coordinates with Logistics Supervisor and Site Manager on shortages. Executes the facility management program, and reports any site repairs and building wear and tear to Logistics Supervisor and Site Manager Participates in logistics synchronization meetings as requested. Performs other duties as assigned. Minimum Qualifications & Skills: Possess an associate degree in an appropriate discipline from an accredited college (a high school diploma with two or more years of relevant experience may be substituted for an associate degree) and, Have at least two years of documented experience in a field related to security, law, social work, detention, corrections, or similar occupational area; certification, licensure, and credentials applicable to the professional accreditation of the position (a minimum of four years of experience is required when a high school diploma with two or more years of relevant experience is substituted for an associate degree). Two or more years’ experience in business, logistics, transportation, supply chain or a related field. Demonstrate basic knowledge of vehicle maintenance (e.g., PM, inspections, safety checks, etc.,) as well as warehouse and inventory procedures (e.g., FIFO concept). Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with employees and with clients. Bilingual in English and Spanish required. Ability to take technical direction and feedback from various sources. Committed to providing outstanding customer service and representation of MVM in a professional manner. Requires the ability to prioritize work, meet stringent deadlines, balance multiple tasks and work in a team environment. Strong attention to detail. Ability to pass a Government Security Background Investigation, including a favorable credit check, no criminal record, and no prior drug use. Work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and graveyard shifts. Demonstrated computer skills including Microsoft Office Suite (Word and Excel). Inventory and surveillance software experience preferred. Possess a valid and current driver’s license with safe driving record. Experience using tablets and smart phone technology. Ability to deliver the highest quality of work under extreme pressure. Analytical and problem-solving skills Work Schedule: This position is mission critical and essential to the ongoing operations and requires a flexible schedule to support a 24/7/365-day operation. Clearance: Applicants selected will be subject to a government background investigation and may be required to meet the following conditions of employment. Security Requirements: Ability to obtain/maintain Security Clearance. Favorable credit check for all cleared positions. Successfully pass a background investigation, drug screen. May be required to pass or present specific requirements depending on the program (e.g., DOT exam, vaccinations, CPR, flu shot). Valid US passport book required or proof of being in the process of obtaining one, depending on the program. US Citizenship Physical Requirements/Working Conditions: Standing/Walking/Mobility : Must have the mobility to attend meetings with other managers and employees. Climbing/Stooping/Kneeling: 0% - 10% of the time Lifting/Pulling/Pushing: 0% - 10% of the time, must be able to lift up to 40 lbs. Fine Motor Skills/Dexterity: Must be able to write, type and use a telephone system 100% of the time. Sitting: Sitting for prolonged and extended periods of time This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may revise duties as necessary without updating this job description. Due to the high volume of applications received, the Talent Acquisition Department will contact you directly, should you be selected to advance in our recruitment process. For more information about the company please visit our website at www.mvminc.com MVM is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, disability or any other federal, state or local protected class. MVM complies with federal and state disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to hrsupport@mvminc.com .
