Product Manager
jd_text: Company: INEOS Oxide Interested in joining a winning team? A team whose employees share in the ownership of the business and are empowered to make a difference? Business Context INEOS is a global manufacturer of petrochemicals and specialty chemicals, producing the raw materials that are essential in the manufacturing of a wide range of goods. The chemicals manufactured by INEOS enhance almost every aspect of modern life. INEOS is the 3rd largest petrochemical company in the world with 194 manufacturing sites across 29 countries and employing more than 26,000 people globally. INEOS Oxide is one of the most diverse, dynamic and successful businesses within INEOS, operating 4 manufacturing sites in Europe and North America. These are located at Antwerp, Belgium; Koln, Germany; Lavera, France; Plaquemine, US. INEOS Oxide is one of the world’s leading producers of Ethylene Oxide (EO) and Ethylene Oxide Derivatives (EODs), producing a broad range of 200+ products spread across 4 key value chains – Ethylene Oxide; Propylene Oxide; Oxo-alcohols & Esters; ENB. The total EO production capacity is currently > 1 million mt and the total production capacity for the overall business is ~ 3.4 million mt. Ethylene oxide (EO) is an important building block for the preparation of a wide variety of EO derivatives (EODs), including various surfactants, as well as many other chemical intermediates including Ethylene Glycols, Glycol Ethers, Polyethylene Glycols and Ethanolamine's. In 2024 INEOS Oxide acquired a new site in Bayport (TX) and the respective business in the US, which increased the total production capacity of the business to ~ 4.4 million mt and through this acquisition INEOS Oxide has achieved a true global footprint, in particular for the Ethylene Oxide value chain. Role Description The Product Manager Ethanolamine's is a key member of the INEOS Oxide US Business Team. The post holder is responsible for providing support to the Business Manager for EOAs across the full extent of the tasks involved with managing the business. Focus will be on: executing and optimizing in-month business performance to maximize EBITDA and cash delivery defining and delivering the rolling three-month business-operating plan with the Business Manager providing/maintaining databases for the annual Operating Plan maintaining a planning and modelling tool for the business that includes all input-variables to enable optimization for the business as the output Ensuring reliable product-movements to ensure optimal plant-operations/run-rates This is achieved by the Product Manager driving and coordinating a large cross-functional business team including procurement, manufacturing, supply chain, customer service and sales managers, and requires the post holder to have a deep and detailed understanding of production asset capabilities and economics, market dynamics, and customers’ service requirements and associated cost-to-serve. The Product Manager performs a key role in monitoring and responding to changing market demand for each individual product group and managing challenges arising from feedstock supply and production reliability issues. INEOS Oxide – Internal Interfaces & Factors The Product Manager will interface with, and positively influence, a large cross functional team across the INEOS Oxide business, as follows: Business Managers & Product Managers – EO swap, EOA sales in Europe, EOA arbitrage, optimizing margins on a global basis together with Lavera EOA volumes. Raw Material Procurement Team – agreeing and executing raw material procurement objectives. Plaquemine Site Operations – monitoring manufacturing performance; managing product supply. Logistics & Supply Chain Teams – agreeing and executing drumming, storage, and transportation requirements. Sales & Customer Service Teams – agreeing and executing the sales and contracting strategies for the business. INEOS Oxide Back-Office Support Functions – dealing with cross business and commercial process issues. Manage day-to-day and mid-term production, sales and margin planning and optimize sales/production variations. Maintain Dashboard and cost/price/margin data to aid in development of long-term plans and presentations. External Interfaces & Factors Executing this role effectively will require a wide-ranging engagement with parties in the external market: Suppliers – supporting the Procurement Team in key raw material supply negotiations. Customers – supporting the Sales Team in key contract preparations and potentially negotiations. Manage Customer relationship and business with 1 critically important customer and possibly up to 3 customers that can have significant impact on the EOA-plant operations Co-producers – supporting the business managers to pursue swap, toll and strategic partnership opportunities. Publications – discussions with publications, supporting Business Manager, to discuss market news and to inform them of INEOS specific information, as appropriate. INEOS O&P US – dealing with Ethylene market information. Legal – work on resolving contract and other challenges that require input from counsel. Technical Service – coordinate Product Data/Specification/Safety Information handling and changes. Accountabilities Accountability 1 - Business Operating Plan Execution Develop and maintain the rolling 3 month operational and financial forecast in line with supply/demand balances and product pricing policy and agree them with the Business Manager prior to his submission of the plan to the company’s formal financial forecasting process. Together with the planner, define and optimize production plan based on demand, inventory and raw material availability, to maximize business EBITDA and cash generation. Monitor and manage supply-demand balances to ensure availability of product for sale, and to ensure EBITDA, cash and working capital targets are met. Implement agreed inventory management strategy to achieve defined stock targets. Under guidance from the Business Manager, assist in defining the monthly and quarterly pricing policy in accordance with market dynamics and the business’ commercial strategy. Implement and manage supply chain solutions in co-operation with Supply Chain/Logistics Function and in accordance with defined business strategy to ensure appropriate levels of delivery service to domestic and export customers for both bulk and packed products. Assist and in alignment with Business Manager manage co-producer commercial interactions in alignment with agreed co-producer strategies and in full compliance with competition law requirements. Organize and facilitate the monthly Business Team Meeting in cooperation with the Business Manager EOAs. Co-ordinate response to customer complaints related to product quality. Ensure that asset maintenance plans are set in coordination with business commercial strategy, ensuring EBITDA, cash and working capital outcomes are optimized. Accountability 2 - Sales Portfolio Management Monitor customer contract compliance; track contract renewal dates to ensure timely renegotiation of contract agreements. Manage EOA-bottoms Key-account relationship and business to assure continuous product-flow and margin. Identify, in collaboration with Sales Team, potential new customers based on the developed contract strategy. Support the Business Manager in preparing for tender and annual contract renegotiations. Identify and appraise new market opportunities for sales / swaps / purchases. Accountability 3 - Market Intelligence and Data Develop strong awareness of market dynamics and trends. Gather market intelligence to ensure visibility of competitor / customer business strategy developments to identify emerging issues and opportunities. Proactively and systematically report key market information to the sales and wider business team, including customer and competitor landscape, notable trends, changes, and risks. Accountability 4 - Business Strategy Development Support the Business Manager in defining annual production, procurement, sales and EBITDA plans. Support the Business Manager in monthly EBITDA forecasting. Support the Business Manager in defining long term commercial and asset growth strategies. Identify and appraise production and supply chain cost reduction opportunities. Identify and appraise production and supply chain infrastructure investment opportunities to enhance capability. Accountability 5 - Safety, Health, and Environmental This position requires that the incumbent commit to learning, following, and practicing INEOS 20 Principles of Process & Behavioral Safety as applicable to the position. These Principles are posted throughout each Oxide facility, and each employee must commit to following the INEOS Life-Saving rules on a daily basis. Key Performance Indicators SHE Performance – Zero incidents. Monthly volume, revenue, contribution and EBITDA performance. Overall INEOS Oxide US Business Team goals - operational, financial, working capital and fixed cost targets. Success in delivering market share growth rates and market development targets for the sales region. Meet all departmental annual training and progression goals 100% compliance in Training and Behavior: EPA ISO GMP DOT OSHA Level of education & experience in general Bachelor in either Chemical or Mechanical engineering preferred; or business/commercial or chemistry degree, provided the person can demonstrate a propensity for and has comfort with technical issues MBA beneficial Minimum 5-10 years of chemical industry commercial experience Profound knowledge of Business, Commercial, Financial, and Technical/Operations Management Technical skills Profound understanding of Business, Finance, Commerce, Contract Law and Production Technology Commercial acumen, demonstrated ability to identify and leverage sources of business value Solid understanding of marketing, sales, and supply chain principles and practices Comprehension of chemical manufacturing processes and practices Effective and efficient computer skills including, but not limited to SAP, Microsoft Office Behavioral skills Decisive and tenacious in pursuit of objectives, demonstrating a proactive mentality and bias for action Ambition and curiosity to push the boundaries of the business Ability to think innovatively and strategically Highly numerate with an analytical mind-set, and attentive to detail Calm under pressure, able to make quick, clear and reasoned decisions in a dynamic business environment Leader of people, effective at engaging others in working together towards a common goal Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, natural relationship builder Coach and developer of people, desire to share learning and help colleagues to achieve results ADA Physical Requirements; Environmental conditions While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and perform tasks requiring repetitive use of hands. The employee must occasionally walk, stand and travel by car, airplane or other means Exert up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects Employee must have the ability to see written documents, computer screens, and to adjust focus Hearing: Perceiving the nature of sounds at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Ability to receive detailed information through oral communication and to make discriminations in sound Work Environment: This job is performed mainly in a temperature-controlled office environment Our culture is one of honesty and integrity with an emphasis on safety, health and environmental performance. On our team, people are acknowledged for embracing new practices that help create real value for customers.

title: Senior Project Manager
jd_text: Company: INEOS Olefins & Polymers USA Interested in joining a winning team? A team whose employees are empowered to make a difference? Job Title: Senior Project Manager Grade: 35/36 Offer Range: $125,050 - $170,000 (commensurate with experience) Location: Hybrid/ Houston Area Operating Sites (Chocolate Bayou, La Porte) INEOS Olefins and Polymers (O&P) USA is a significant entity as part of the INEOS group of companies. title: Senior Product Manager - HRScale
jd_text: Insperity provides the most comprehensive suite of scalable HR solutions available in the marketplace with an optimal blend of premium HR service and technology. With more than 90 locations throughout the U.S., Insperity is currently making a difference for thousands of businesses and communities nationwide. Behind our success is the unshakeable belief in the value of our people. We value diversity, inclusivity and a sense of belonging. We celebrate work and life events, and we partner with our clients and communities to make great things happen. We’ve earned recognition time and again as a top place to work—named among the best by respected organizations like Glassdoor and U.S. News & World Report. We’re also proud to be recognized for one of the country’s Top 50 Midsize Early Talent Programs through RippleMatch’s Campus Forward Awards. There’s never been a better time to be part of Insperity, and our best work is still ahead. Learn more at Insperity.com. Why Insperity? Flexibility: Over 80% of Insperity’s jobs have flexibility. We want your time to have balance, whether it’s spent with coworkers, clients, family or your community. Career Growth: Insperity provides many ways to grow with the company. We offer continuous learning programs, mentorship opportunities and ongoing training. Well-Being: Our total rewards package includes generous paid time off, top-tier medical, dental and vision benefits, health & wellness support, paid volunteer hours and much more. We take care of our people so that you can do your best work. We are seeking a talented Senior Product Manager - HRScale to join our team. Insperity is advancing HRScale, a co-developed solution with Workday that brings enterprise-class human capital management capabilities to the middle market in an entirely new way. HRScale pairs Workday’s HCM technology with Insperity’s industry-leading PEO co-employment model, and high-touch service delivery to help larger, more complex clients manage their workforce with greater confidence, agility, and scale. As Senior Product Manager, HRScale, you will help shape the next stage of growth for one of Insperity’s most strategic product offerings. You will contribute to the vision, strategy, roadmap, adoption, and commercial success of HRScale across Insperity’s up-market portfolio. Working at the intersection of client needs, product strategy, the Workday partnership, technology, and service delivery, you will collaborate with others to identify the highest-value opportunities to improve the client experience, help us make disciplined investment and prioritization decisions, and guide cross-functional teams from concept through launch and ongoing growth. This is a high-impact opportunity to define and optimize a strategic solution inside an established company with deep HR expertise, strong client relationships, and a differentiated service model. You will not simply manage a roadmap or coordinate partner activity. You will help answer the harder product questions: where should HRScale go next, what client and business problems must it solve better, how should Insperity deliver the solution well at scale, and how will we know it is creating real value for the business and the clients we serve? RESPONSIBILITIES: Product Strategy & Market Development Evolves the vision, strategy, and multi-horizon roadmap for HRScale, Insperity’s flagship up-market HCM solution, aligned with enterprise strategy, solution priorities, business objectives and market needs. Coordinates with Enterprise Analytics and partners across the organization to conduct market research, client interviews, and competitive analysis to identify customer needs, market trends, and business opportunities. Builds business cases and facilitates internal alignment and investment decisions required to advance product strategies. Identifies must‑have requirements and key differentiators to be reflected in product capabilities, marketing strategy, and service delivery standards. End-to-End Product Ownership Serves as an accountable owner for HRScale across the full lifecycle, from concept through launch, scale and ongoing evolution. Uses an understanding of the strategy for Insperity’s up-market solutions to inform actionable roadmaps, phased investments, pilot initiatives, and scalable operating models. Makes or recommends, as appropriate, disciplined trade‑off decisions across scope, sequencing, and investment, balancing client value, scalability, and commercial outcomes. Acts to reduce ambiguity and clarify ownership by providing clear direction and decision rights to continually improve product performance. Commercial Success & Product Performance Management Drives the overall commercial success of HRScale, including growth, sustainability, and scalability. Partners with Finance and Enterprise Analytics to understand revenue drivers, cost‑to‑serve dynamics, and product economics. Defines and updates ongoing product success metrics and reviews performance to inform decisions and continuous improvement. Identifies opportunities to improve pricing, packaging, margin profile, and operational leverage, elevating recommendations as appropriate. Decision Authority & Governance Acts as a decision authority for product‑level decisions within defined scope. Makes decisions regarding prioritization of enhancements and changes to the product, in the context of available resources and higher-level priorities. Elevates decisions requiring Product Management leadership, Solution Management, and/or Management Team approval (e.g., pricing, major new investments, sunsetting) with clear recommendations, supporting analysis, and trade‑off considerations. Ensures products within defined scope are represented consistently and effectively in portfolio management and governance forums. Cross Functional Leadership & Execution Collaborates with cross‑functional teams including Technology, Service Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Gross Profit Operations to define requirements for capabilities – both technology and service delivery – that will meet client needs and work for Insperity. Coordinates with others in Product Management and Solution Management roles to ensure alignment between solution‑level strategy, product-level strategy and underlying capabilities and product roadmaps. Recognizes the need for change and leads through influence and intentional communication to drive alignment and execution of plans. Serves as the internal champion for assigned products by clearly articulating strategy and direction based on market insights and client feedback. Market, Client & Sales Enablement Represents the voice of the client and market for HRScale and the client needs the solution addresses. Gathers and incorporates feedback from clients, Sales, Service Operations, and internal stakeholders to address existing and emerging needs and validate ideal customer profile. Partners with Sales and Marketing to support clear selling motions, product narratives, enablement materials, and strategic opportunities. Partner Management Manages product level relationships with strategic external partners that enable or support assigned solutions. Coordinates with Corporate Development and other stakeholders to identify opportunities to evolve, expand, or supplement partnerships based on strategic direction and market needs. Ensures partner dependencies, risks, and roadmap considerations are understood and reflected in product and solution planning. QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s Degree in a related field, or related work experience is required. 5+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, or service design/delivery/management. Proven experience leading cross-functional initiatives. Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in matrixed organizations. Master’s Degree (MBA or equivalent) is preferred. Experience with HR solutions, enterprise software, or tech‑enabled services. Experience working with external partners supporting complex solutions. Strong analytical skills with experience developing business cases and evaluating trade‑offs. Background in both technology and service-based product offerings. Strong understanding of customer needs and ability to translate them into product direction. Aptitude to accept complex assignments, analyze problems, and generate effective solutions. Ability to apply a systematic method to problem solving, analyze data, and recommend strategies that support positive business results. Strong analytical abilities, results oriented nature, the ability to manage multiple projects, work independently or as part of a team, and plan, organize and complete assignments timely. Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, verbally and in writing, effectively present complex, financial information; work effectively and accurately under narrow time limitations; work effectively with others; work independently from general instructions; and maintain effective work relations with those encountered in the course of employment. Ability to manage multiple projects at one time. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across teams. Ability to operate independently and make informed decisions within defined scope. Strong collaboration skills in a cross-functional, matrixed environment. Bias for action, continuous improvement, and delivering meaningful outcomes. This job specification should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbent will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required by the supervisor. At Insperity, we celebrate the diversity of our employees and our leadership. Insperity is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Partner Development Business Analyst
jd_text: The Partner Development Business Analyst supports the Partner Development team through business analysis, operational oversight, and process improvement initiatives. Strong Salesforce experience with a demonstrated understanding of CRM governance, sales pipeline management, reporting, and data integrity. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with business reporting and analytical tools. Experience analyzing business performance and providing reports, dashboards, insights, and recommendations to management. Proven ability to evaluate business processes, identify risks and inefficiencies, and recommend practical, results-oriented solutions. Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and cross-functional initiatives. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders. Experience working in SaaS, technology, sports technology, education technology, or a related business environment. title: Project Manager, Implementation
jd_text: As a Project Manager on SIDEARM's Implementation team, you will play a key role in how our client work gets planned, coordinated, and delivered. You will be part of the operational engine that brings SIDEARM's digital products to life for our athletic department partners — from website redesigns and mobile app launches to the migration of clients onto our next-generation content management system (CMS). SIDEARM is the digital platform powering collegiate athletics for hundreds of institutions, and this role sits at the intersection of client experience, cross-functional execution, and operational excellence. In this role, you will manage the day-to-day execution of client implementation projects, keep timelines and deliverables on track, facilitate cross-team coordination, client communication and help ensure our clients have exceptional experience from contract signing through launch and onboarding. You will collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Product, Partner Development and Client Support to keep work moving and communication clear. This role reports to the Director, Implementation. Essential Duties & Responsibilities: Project Execution & Delivery Own the day-to-day execution of assigned client implementation projects — these could include athletic website redesigns, mobile app implementations, third-party feature activations, new client migrations and platform launches — from kickoff through launch. Manage project scope, timeline, dependencies, and deliverables using Jira, Confluence and slack, ensuring the team always has clear visibility into what's next and what's at risk. Facilitate project kickoffs, working sessions and status reviews with clients and internal teams to keep work moving and expectations aligned. Track project health, timelines, and scope changes, surfacing issues and blockers early rather than at the finish line. Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for client stakeholders during implementation, building trust and delivering a smooth, professional experience. Client Partnership & Cross-Functional Coordination Translate client needs into clear implementation plans, working closely with Design, Engineering, Partner Development and Product to bring them to life. Communicate proactively with clients on status, milestones, decisions, and next steps. Support the transition from implementation to ongoing support and account management to ensure a clean handoff. Build strong working relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, and Client Support to keep dependencies clear and work moving forward. CMS Migration & Platform Delivery Play a key role in the migration of clients to SIDEARM's next-generation CMS, coordinating the technical, content, and communication work required for a successful transition. Partner with Client Support and Product to ensure clients feel supported throughout the migration and have the resources they need. Coordinate work involving third-party features and vendors (such as Noda, Level Access, Game Center) as part of the implementation lifecycle. Document and share lessons learned across the team as we scale the migration program and expand the implementation function. Accountability & Continuous Improvement Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation of project status, decisions, and outcomes in Confluence and Jira. Contribute to a team culture where deadlines are treated as commitments and blockers are surfaced early with proposed paths forward. Look for opportunities to streamline processes, reduce friction, and make the implementation function more effective over time. Stay current on evolving project management tools and approaches, including AI-powered workflow tools like Claude, and bring new ideas to the team. Minimum Qualifications: 3+ years of experience in project management, project coordination, client implementation, or client-facing operations — ideally in a SaaS, digital platform, website development or professional services environment. Experience managing client-facing projects from planning through delivery, with a track record of hitting timelines and delivering strong client experiences. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously without losing detail. Clear and confident communicator, written and verbal, comfortable working across both technical and non-technical audiences. title: Technical Team Lead, PP/Utilities
jd_text: Company: INEOS Olefins & Polymers USA Interested in joining a winning team? A team whose employees are empowered to make a difference? Job Title: PP/Utilities Technical Team Lead Job Location: Chocolate Bayou Works in Alvin, TX Offer Range: $160,000 - $200,000 (commensurate with experience) Organizational Context and Job Purpose The Olefins & Polymers USA division of INEOS is one of the largest producers of olefins and polyolefins in North America. From its manufacturing locations at Chocolate Bayou and the Battleground Manufacturing Complex, it is a merchant marketer of butadiene, ethylene, polypropylene and high-density polyethylene with annual revenue of over $4B. The Chocolate Bayou Site is located in Southeastern Texas about 40 miles South of Houston and consists of two Olefins units that produce approximately 4bn pounds/year of ethylene, 2 Polypropylene units that produce approximately 1B pounds/ year of polypropylene, and the Light Ends storage & transfer facilities at Stratton Ridge. The Technical Team Lead provides technical, strategic, and people leadership to drive durable economic value through optimization, debottlenecking, and long‑term technology planning. This role is accountable for translating data, operational insight, and technology expertise into clear strategic direction and decision‑ready recommendations that improve yield, energy efficiency, throughput, and asset utilization. The Technical Team Lead ensures that value is systematically identified, rigorously quantified, and effectively institutionalized, such that improvements are repeatable, governed, and sustained over time—not dependent on individual effort. This role bridges short‑term operational realities and long‑term asset strategy, aligning optimization priorities, technology roadmaps, and capital investment decisions with broader business objectives. Acting as the steward of the site’s long‑range performance outlook, the Technical Team Lead partners closely with Capital Projects, Operations, and Business Teams , to ensure the plant consistently operates closer to its economic and technical limits, without compromising safety, reliability, or compliance. Success is measured by sustained improvement in asset economics and decision quality, even when the team is not directly engaged in the day‑to‑day. The Technical Team Lead reports to the Site Technical Manager . This position is part of the technical team at the Chocolate Bayou Works and provides technical support to two Polypropylene Units, a Utilities Unit and a Cogeneration facility. Responsibilities & Accountabilities Key Roles and Accountabilities The position is accountable for understanding and putting into practice the INEOS 20 Principles. Additionally, the Technical Team Lead has a special responsibility to cascade the understanding of these principles through their team. Leadership & Team Management Lead, coach, and develop the technical team. Establish performance expectations and accountability. Promote disciplined execution and technical rigor. Strategy, Optimization & Value Creation Identify and prioritize optimization and debottlenecking opportunities. Own and govern opportunity registers. Drive sustained economic improvement. Technology & Intellectual Asset Stewardship Develop and maintain multi-year technology roadmaps. Steward analytical models and technical studies. Capital Investment & Project Support Own CAPEX investment plans for optimization initiatives. Support FEL development and capital justifications. Cross-Functional Integration & Influence Interface with manufacturing, asset, and project teams. Translate technical analysis into decision-ready insight. Key Success Indicators Sustained improvement in asset economics. High-quality strategic and optimization studies. Durable institutionalized gains. Skills & Knowledge Required Education & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or related discipline; advanced degree preferred. Typically 10 to 15 years relevant experience in chemical, petrochemical, or large-scale industrial manufacturing environments. Prior experience leading or mentoring technical professionals strongly preferred. Technical skills Advanced understanding of process technology, unit operations, and asset constraints. Strong capability in process modeling, heat and material balances, and scenario analysis to support optimization and strategic decision‑making. Demonstrated expertise in optimization, debottlenecking, and yield/energy efficiency analysis with quantified economic impact. Proficiency in technical‑economic evaluation, including ROI analysis, cost‑curve positioning, and value‑capture prioritization. Experience developing and governing multi‑year technology roadmaps aligned with business and asset strategy. Ability to identify and assess technology gaps, capability limits, and upgrade pathways through benchmarking and long‑range studies. Working knowledge of capital project development processes (FEL 0/1), including technology scoping, business justification, and option evaluation. Strong understanding of asset economics, unit cost drivers, and profitability analysis. Experience stewarding process models, technical studies, and intellectual assets with disciplined governance. Solid grounding in process safety, reliability principles, and operational risk considerations related to optimization and technology change. Ability to translate complex technical analyses into clear, decision‑ready recommendations for leadership. Leadership & Behavioral skills Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and develop technical professionals, creating an environment where individuals are empowered to perform at their best. Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work persuasively and credibly across disciplines and at all organizational levels. Proven capability to lead diverse teams and align stakeholders around shared objectives and strategic priorities. Effective at prioritizing work to ensure focus on the most critical, highest‑value activities. Ability to delegate work appropriately, with clear expectations, accountability, and follow‑through. Comfortable and effective engaging with senior leadership, translating complex technical topics into clear, decision‑ready insight. Demonstrates sound judgment, problem‑solving capability, and a sense of urgency appropriate to business‑critical decisions. Models a strong work ethic and ownership mindset, while reinforcing sustainable performance through the team rather than personal effort alone. Line Management Responsibility The PP/Utilities Technical Team Lead has 2 to 3 direct reports. Our culture is one of honesty and integrity with an emphasis on safety, health and environmental performance. On our team, people are acknowledged for embracing new practices that help create real value for customers.

title: Senior Manager, Oracle EPM Platforms
jd_text: Position Summary We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager to serve as the architect and platform owner for our Oracle Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) Cloud landscape, spanning EPBCS (Planning & Budgeting), FCCS (Financial Consolidation), ARCS (Account Reconciliation) and EDMCS (Enterprise Data Management). This role owns the end-to-end architecture, integration design, and roadmap across all four platforms, and acts as the primary escalation point our internal teams & vendors. The role is expected to lead concurrent EPM implementation and enhancement projects. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable writing calculation manager scripts and Groovy business rules as they are setting strategy with finance and IT leadership — someone who can design, build, and troubleshoot personally, while directing and holding both a managed service team and parallel implementation teams accountable to timelines, quality, and roadmap commitments. Key Responsibilities Architecture & Platform Ownership • Own the end-to-end solution architecture across EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS, and EDMCS, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, and aligned to enterprise data and finance standards. • Design and build EPM Cloud configurations (Essbase/hybrid, business rules, calculation manager scripts, Groovy business rules, task lists, forms, and dashboards) directly, without relying solely on the managed service team for build work. • Architect and maintain integrations between EDMCS and downstream applications (EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS) to ensure consistent dimensionality, mappings, and hierarchy governance across the metadata model. • Design and support data integration pipelines (EPM Automate, REST APIs, Data Management/FDMEE, Data Integration) between EPM applications, the GL/ERP source systems, and downstream reporting tools. • Configure and optimize reconciliation rules, matching logic, and workflows for account reconciliations in ARCS, aligned with close calendar and controls requirements. Key Responsibilities • Define and maintain the multi-year technology roadmap for the EPM platform footprint, incorporating Oracle's quarterly cloud release features, new capabilities, and deprecations. • Direct and coordinate EPM support team, acting as the primary point of contact for day-to-day operations, incident escalation, enhancement requests, and release coordination. • Review and validate MSP deliverables (SLAs, response/resolution times, ticket quality, code/config standards) against contractual and internal expectations, and drive corrective action when performance slips. • Author technical specifications and architecture guardrails for tasks assigned to the managed service team, including detailed requirements, test plans, and acceptance criteria, to ensure work is built correctly the first time. • Serve as the technical liaison between the MSP and internal stakeholders, translating business requirements into technical scope the service team can execute against. • Manage the shared backlog of enhancements, defects, and change requests across all four platforms, prioritizing based on business impact, risk, and platform roadmap. Stakeholder & Team Leadership • Partner directly with FP&A, Accounting/Controllership, and Financial Reporting leadership to translate evolving business requirements into platform enhancements. • Present regularly on architecture decisions, platform health, roadmap progress, and risk to finance and IT executive leadership. • Maintain deep functional knowledge of the underlying business processes (planning, consolidation, reconciliation, and master data management) to design fit-for-purpose solutions rather than one-off fixes. • Mentor or oversee a small internal team of EPM analysts/administrators where applicable, in addition to managing the external managed service relationship. Platform Scope Direct architectural and functional ownership across the following Oracle EPM Cloud modules: • EPBCS (Enterprise Planning & Budgeting Cloud Service): Multi-dimensional planning, budgeting, and forecasting models; Smart View/Web forms; business rules; workforce, capital, and project planning modules as applicable. • FCCS (Financial Consolidation & Close Cloud Service): Financial consolidation, intercompany eliminations, currency translation, ownership management, and close process automation. • ARCS (Account Reconciliation Cloud Service): Reconciliation compliance, transaction matching, integration with source sub-ledgers, and close task automation. • EDMCS (Enterprise Data Management Cloud Service): Enterprise dimension and hierarchy governance, metadata synchronization, and mapping across all connected EPM and ERP applications. Required Qualifications • 8+ years of progressive experience in Finance Systems, IT, or Enterprise Applications, with at least 4+ years in a hands-on Oracle EPM architect or lead role. • Demonstrated hands-on experience building configuring, and supporting at least three of the four platforms: EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS, EDMCS. • Prior experience managing a managed service provider (MSP) or managing outsourced/offshore application support teams against SLAs. • Proven track record running multiple concurrent EPM implementation projects (e.g., new module rollouts, upgrades, migrations) alongside steady-state managed services, including coordinating systems integrators or contract resources across overlapping timelines. • Strong working knowledge with EPM Automate, REST/SOAP APIs, Groovy (business rule scripting), Data Management/FDMEE, and Smart View. • Solid understanding of Essbase concepts (block storage/aggregate storage), dimension design, and calculation logic. • Working knowledge of core FP&A, consolidation, and account reconciliation business processes and controls (e.g., SOX). • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to finance executives. • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Preferred Qualifications • Oracle EPM Cloud certification(s) (e.g., Oracle EPM Cloud implementation certifications for Planning, FCCS, ARCS, or EDMCS). • Prior experience in a multi-entity, multi-currency organization supporting a large or global enterprise environment. • Experience integrating EPM Cloud (e.g., through Data Integration/FDMEE) to major ERP platforms (Oracle Fusion, SAP, Workday, NetSuite, etc.). • SQL or scripting experience (PowerShell, Python, VBScript, or similar) for automation of EPM operational tasks. • Familiarity of Oracle's quarterly readiness process and change management practices for cloud EPM environments. Key Competencies • Hands-on technical depth. Able to write scripts, calc rules, and integrations personally, not only review others' work. • Systems thinking. Sees the platform landscape as one connected ecosystem rather than four siloed tools. • Vendor/service management. Comfortable directing a third-party team's day-to-day work while owning ultimate accountability for outcomes. • Judgment under pressure. Able to balance urgent break-fix needs with long-term roadmap and architecture integrity. • Ownership. Drives issues to resolution and proactively identifies risks before they affect the close or planning cycle. • Parallel workstream management. Can run several implementation workstreams and the managed service queue at once without losing track of dependencies or priorities. title: Principal Product Manager, Consumer Digital Experience
jd_text: Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future. As a Consumer Domain Principal Product Manager, you'll own how we engage and personalize for consumers globally across all digital touchpoints. That means both we build the channels themselves around the consumer. This is your first mandate inside the broader Consumer Domain, and as you improve impact here, scope can expand into adjacent parts of the consumer journey. You'll start by building a clear, evidence-based view of where our current engagement channels and personalization capabilities are helping or holding us back — and make the call on what comes next. This is a senior individual contributor role. You won't manage a team, own a budget, or run sprint execution. However, you will lead the outcomes of this domain end-to-end, from assessment to roadmap to what ships. You'll partner with multiple teams across our global footprint, including engineering, data science, design, marketing/CRM, legal/privacy, and regional/market teams. You'll work with them to turn your recommendations into requirements. Additionally, you'll collaborate with Directors and VPs to understand how this domain connects to the broader consumer experience. The goal of this domain: consumers everywhere feel like we know them — the right message, on the right channel, at the right moment, no matter where they are in the world. Success is engagement and personalization performance that measurably improves over time. This roadmap supports this performance because it grounds itself in evidence rather than opinion, and the business puts its trust in it. Additionally, it involves engagement infrastructure that gets smarter — not just bigger — as we scale into new markets and channels. About the Job Assess & Set the Consumer Engagement & Personalization Agenda Assess how well our current communications digital channels serve consumers across our global markets. Build a fact-based point of view on what's working, what isn't, and where the highest-use opportunities are. Diagnose how personalized our consumer engagement is today, from basic segmentation to real-time, individualized decisioning. Define the roadmap to close the gap between where we are and where we need to be. Lead the multi-year vision and prioritized roadmap for consumer engagement and personalization, translating your assessment into a clear set of recommendations and work tracks. Manage the trade-offs across recommendations: what we invest in first, what we deprioritize, and why. Platform & Personalization Infrastructure Decisions Make build-vs-buy-vs-partner recommendations for the foundational capabilities behind personalization and engagement. These capabilities include whether we need a customer data platform (CDP), a recommendation or decisioning engine, stronger pipelines into our communications platform, or new orchestration tooling. Defend these recommendations. Define the data and signals — purchase history, browse behavior, preferences, lifecycle stage — that should improve personalization, and oversee the requirements that make those signals usable in real-time across channels. Write the PRDs, briefs, and requirements that turn your recommendations into build-ready work for engineering, data science, and product teams. Stay close to delivery, not just requirements — unblock trade-offs in-flight and remain accountable for what ships, not just what's written down. Global & Market-Specific Strategy Determine where a single global approach to engagement and personalization makes sense. Identify where strategies specific to the market are needed. Run tests to compare tactics across regions, and other markets we operate in, rather than assuming a one-size-fits-all strategy. Identify which personalization signals and logic generalize globally and which need local tuning — product, size, or content relevance often differs by region, on top of channel and regulatory differences. Partner with regional and market teams to understand local channel norms, consumer behavior, and regulatory requirements, and factor them into your roadmap. Build the frameworks, strategies, and shared tooling that let regional teams move fast without fragmenting the underlying platform. Measurement & Continuous Optimization Define the engagement and personalization metrics that matter globally and by market and oversee the test-and-learn agenda that improves them. Run a disciplined, cross-market experimentation pace, working in the data (SQL, dashboards, experiment results) to determine what generalizes globally versus what you need to localize. Cross-Functional & Executive Alignment Collaborate and influence the engineering, data science, design, and partner teams, keeping them aligned to one prioritized set of investments rather than competing asks. Represent the consumer engagement and personalization domain in cross-functional planning and annual operating plan (AOP) cycles and make the case for investment — including new platforms or infrastructure — to Directors and VPs. Mentor Senior PMs and PMs across markets on personalization and lifecycle craft, and raise the department's bar for how data and AI show up in consumer engagement globally. About You Bachelor's degree required. Have 8+ years of experience in product management. This experience includes direct ownership of a consumer-facing product, such as personalization or consumer engagement platforms (email, push, SMS). This experience would have a global or multi-market scope. Experience with personalization techniques — segmentation, rules-based targeting, and ML-driven recommendations/decisioning — and judgment for when each is the right tool for the job. Experience diagnosing personalization maturity. Build the business case for what closes the gap, e.g., CDPs, data pipelines across tools, decisioning/orchestration layers, including build-vs-buy-vs-partner calls. Experience shipping a roadmap of connected plans — not just setting strategy. You can point to specific recommendations, features, or campaigns you specified and shipped, and the results they drove. Experience adapting product, engagement, or personalization strategy across regions or markets (e.g., the U.S., Europe, APAC, or similar), including navigating region-specific regulatory and channel norms. Experience partnering with data science/ML teams on personalization or decisioning models. Have expert-level fluency in AI system design. This includes orchestration, human-in-the-loop patterns, and their trade-offs, such as latency, cost, accuracy, and responsible use. Comfortable working directly in the data — SQL, dashboards, and experiment design — including comparing results across markets to make and defend prioritization calls. Experience collaborating and influencing teams, including engineering, data science, design, CRM/lifecycle, legal/privacy, and regional/market. Partner with these teams across different regions without formal authority. Additionally, I am comfortable operating across time zones with globally distributed partners. This is an individual contributor role. It does not include people management, budget/vendor ownership, or sprint execution. However, you will be the clear, accountable owner of the consumer engagement and personalization roadmap and its requirements. Experience in retail, apparel, or e-commerce personalization at scale, across multiple international markets. Experience with identity resolution, data clean rooms, or cross-device matching for personalization. Experience applying generative AI to content or creative personalization, including localized or multi-language content. This role is remote work eligible within the U.S. or can work on a hybrid basis out of our San Francisco, CA headquarters. The expected starting salary range for this role is $147,000 - 240,000 per year. We may pay more or less than the posted range based on the location of the role. We will base the amount an employee will earn within the salary range on factors such as relevant education, qualifications, performance and our needs. Levi Strauss & Co. (LS&Co.) offers a total rewards package that includes base pay, incentive plans, 401(k) matching, paid leave, health insurance, product discounts, and more designed to help you and your family stay healthy, meet your financial goals, and balance the demands of your work and personal life. Available benefits and incentive compensation vary depending upon the specifics of the role; details relating to a specific role will be made available upon request. jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong><span style="font-size: 14pt;">About Us</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!</span></p></div><h3><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About the Role</strong></span></h3> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">DriveWealth LLC is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Security &amp; Threat Operations Manager to build and mature the function protecting our brokerage platform and corporate environment. Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you will grow and lead the team, establish its operating model and roadmap, and deliver measurable improvements in threat detection, investigation, incident response, and exposure management.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><br>In this hands-on leadership role, you will own detection content and the exposure management lifecycle, security monitoring and incident response, operation and tuning of security controls, and turn threat intelligence into defensive improvements. You will act as Incident Commander during significant security incidents and coordinate response across technical and business teams. Partnering with Security Engineering, DevOps &amp; Platform, and Product &amp; Engineering, you will ensure defenses evolve along with our AWS platform, Kubernetes services, low-latency trading infrastructure, and corporate technology within an innovative and entrepreneurial culture.<br><br></span></p> <h3><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></span></h3> <p><strong>Program Maturity &amp; Team Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Program Development: Mature Security &amp; Threat Operations through a measurable roadmap, defined operating model, appropriate monitoring coverage, escalation procedures, and service provider oversight.</li> <li>Team Development: Grow and lead the team through hiring, coaching, training, career development, and performance management.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Threat Detection, Investigation &amp; Intelligence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Detection Engineering: Own the detection program incorporating threat intelligence, content development, proactive hunting, and validation through attack simulations and purple-team exercises. Treat detection content development as an engineering discipline.</li> <li>Monitoring &amp; Investigation: Own security monitoring and investigation across product and corporate environments, including phishing, malware, credential compromise, API abuse, DDoS, and insider threats.</li> <li>Digital Risk Monitoring: Own digital risk monitoring covering external attack surfaces, leaked credentials, exposed data, impersonation, phishing domains, and takedown coordination.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Incident Response</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automated Response: Partner with Security Engineering to build pre-defined automated security response actions. Coordinate with business leaders on required response actions which cannot be automated or which require compensating actions to prevent unnecessary business disruption.</li> <li>Incident Management: Own the incident response lifecycle as Incident Commander, including preparedness, forensic evidence handling, containment, recovery validation, regulatory coordination, and post-incident improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Exposure Management &amp; Control Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure Management: Own the exposure management lifecycle from discovery through verified closure, coordinating remediation with accountable system and product owners.</li> <li>Control Operations: Own the operation and tuning of operational security controls, such as DLP, WAF, email filtering, and identity compromise prevention in partnership with Security Engineering, DevOps &amp; Platform, and Product &amp; Engineering to meet evolving product and corporate technology requirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compliance &amp; Assurance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Regulatory Controls: Partner with Legal, Compliance, Security Engineering and GRC to implement SEC and FINRA requirements, including SEC Rule 17a-3 and 17a-4 controls supporting record capture, preservation, integrity, access, and retrieval.</li> <li>Control Assurance: Partner with Security Engineering to automate control validation and evidence collection. Support audits and regulatory examinations, and drive remediation of technical findings.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>You Bring</strong></span></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years in security operations, detection engineering, incident response, or related disciplines, including 3+ years managing technical teams and experience building or maturing an operations function.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience serving as Incident Commander during significant security incidents, making decisions under pressure, coordinating multiple teams, and communicating clearly with executives and business stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong hands-on expertise in threat intelligence, detection content development, SIEM and endpoint analytics, investigation, threat hunting, and defensive validation.</li> <li>Practical scripting or query skills in Python, SQL, or comparable languages.</li> <li>Working knowledge of AWS, Kubernetes, API security, identity, and Windows/macOS endpoint telemetry. Experience supporting production environments with demanding availability and latency requirements is preferred.</li> <li>Experience creating, operating, and tuning preventive controls such as DLP, WAF, and email filtering while managing false positives and business impact.</li> <li>Experience investigating insider threats and digital risks such as exposed credentials, impersonation, and phishing domains, with appropriate handling of sensitive information and coordination with HR and Legal.</li> <li>Strong people leadership, process design, and prioritization skills, with the ability to influence Engineering and IT, manage competing operational demands, and support on-call escalation and incident response outside normal business hours.</li> <li>Familiarity with NIST CSF, incident response practices, and MITRE ATT&amp;CK. Experience in regulated financial services, including SEC/FINRA environments and applicable incident, data protection, and recordkeeping obligations, is preferred.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, or GCFA are a plus.</li> </ul> <h3><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Location</strong></h3> <p>This role is open to candidates in the following locations: <strong>New York City, Chicago, Austin, Dallas, Denver, Miami, San Francisco Bay Area, or Seattle</strong>.&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If based in New York or Chicago: This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.</li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If based in Austin, Dallas, Denver, Miami, San Francisco, or Seattle: This is a fully remote role, though you may need to visit our onsite offices from time to time.</li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Pay Range</strong>: $200,000 – $250,000 USD</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Working at DriveWealth</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.</span></p> <p data-path-to-node="5"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong><span style="font-size: 14pt;">Work Authorization</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>How We Think About AI</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Compensation</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.&nbsp; If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Agency Disclaimer</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.</span></p></div>

title: Insurance Application Analyst

title: Lead, Residential Solar Service Operations
jd_text: Job Summary: As Lead, Residential Solar Service Operations, you will play a key role in leading a team that oversees the performance, operations, and maintenance of our residential solar portfolio while managing strategic partner and contractor relationships. In this role, you will be responsible for facilitating the resolution of maintenance issues, managing service invoices and costs, validating system operation, and ensuring seamless communication between internal teams, contractors, and customers. You will lead and develop a team of service partners to limit service tickets, resolve issues remotely, and resolve system issues efficiently, while communicating insights to partners to drive scalability, efficiency, and best-in-class service across a 500 MW+ residential solar business. Primary Responsibilities: Partner Management: Manage ongoing relationships with IGS’s partners to ensure operational and financial success for both our partners and IGS Solar. Coordinate with service providers and internal teams to resolve maintenance issues quickly and efficiently. Foster strong relationships with service providers, ensuring alignment with company service standards and requirements. Monitor contractor performance, compliance, and adherence to service level agreements, addressing any concerns proactively. Partner with Accounts Payable to resolve contractor payment or remittance issues; review contractor expenses and approve invoices for payment, ensuring accuracy and alignment with budget expectations. Work collaboratively to identify, research, and resolve partner issues swiftly and completely by leveraging an expert-level understanding of the business. Team Leadership & Development: Lead the service team, including day-to-day management, training, and development of individual contributors. Mentor and support the team, providing guidance and day-to-day leadership to ensure high-quality service execution. Build and empower team members to grow in their careers and become more effective in the industry. Create and modify user guides, job aids, and documentation for training purposes. Program Expertise & Training: Act as an Asset Management 360 platform expert, guiding new service partners through the onboarding process, ensuring clear understanding of IGS’s internal CRM, service requirements, and processes. Create clear instructional materials and deliver ad hoc training sessions with existing partners to maintain alignment with requirements. Assist service partners with education and training on IGS standards for solar installations & maintenance. Coordinate with IT to identify and resolve platform issues efficiently with minimum interruption to business processes. Operational Efficiency & Reporting: Compile key reports and dashboards to gauge and grade partnerships across relevant metrics, such as first truck roll resolution rates, time to resolution, cost, and operational efficiency. Lead analysis of reports on maintenance trends and service case resolutions to drive data-driven decision-making. Collaborate with leadership to develop and refine workflows that enhance operational efficiency and service quality. Ensure the team maintains detailed documentation related to site visits, maintenance requests, and service activities; audit documentation to ensure accurate recordkeeping and compliance with best practices. Contribute to special projects and initiatives to support the continued growth and success of the Residential Solar business. Coordinate with leadership to identify and mitigate areas of risk exposure. Required Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both verbal and written, to interact effectively with customers, contractors, and partners. Demonstrates a drive for results, efficiency, and embraces the value of Continuous Improvement. Ability to adapt, evolve, and thrive in an ever-changing environment. Exceptional organizational skills and document management skills with an acute attention to detail. Positive attitude, self-motivated, strong analytical skills, results oriented, driven. Ability to navigate complex resolutions and master new technologies and platforms (e.g., IGS’s proprietary platform, partner portals, reporting portals, invoicing systems). Experience collaborating cross-functionally, internally and externally, to ensure seamless partner and customer experiences. Ability to simultaneously manage dozens of service contractor partnerships, multiple projects, and competing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic industry. Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Advanced knowledge of the Operation and Maintenance of photovoltaic systems. Minimum Education and Experience: Degree in Business Administration, IT, Operations, Renewable Energy focused, or other applicable field of study a plus, but not required. 2-4+ years of experience in the Solar or Energy industry. Familiarity with multiple Residential Solar system architectures. 3+ years of experience using Excel for analysis and as a tool to communicate complex data effectively. NABCEP professional certification a plus. Relevant manufacturer install certifications a plus. Experience with Solar Shading tools such as Aurora/Solmetric Suneye preferred. Familiarity with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software a plus. Intermediate skills in all MS Office Applications (Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, SharePoint). title: Solutions Architect IV, Procurement
jd_text: By living according to a common set of values, we create a culture that unifies, embraces the uniqueness we all bring to the company, and positions Integer for long-term success. At Integer, our values are embedded in everything we do. Customer We focus on our customers’ success Innovation We create better solutions Collaboration We create success together Inclusion We always interact with others respectfully Candor We are open and honest with one another Integrity We do the right things and do things right &#xa; What is Project Symphony? To advance us further along our journey to excellence at Integer Holdings Corporation, we are launching Symphony, a program that will implement an updated enterprise resource planning (ERP) system and establish enterprise-wide standard processes and structure. This includes ensuring Symphony directly enables the Integer Production System, including elements such as the production monitoring and improvement process, sales, inventory, and operations planning. The program will effect change across the company, which will have a direct impact on optimizing business processes, enhancing operational efficiency, and positioning Integer for continued success. Symphony is about having the right business processes in place supported by a single, modern, integrated ERP platform . What you’ll do in this role: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Procurement Architect with deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA and Ariba Suite to join our ERP Center of Excellence (CoE). This role will play a pivotal part in the implementation of SAP and provide ongoing support and optimization of the platform post go-live. The ideal candidate will bring strong functional knowledge of Procurement processes, architectural design capabilities, and a strategic mindset to help shape the future of our ERP landscape. Key Responsibilities: Lead procurement transformation initiatives using SAP S/4HANA and Ariba suite (Sourcing, Contracts, Buying, Invoicing, Supplier Lifecycle & Performance, and Business Network). Help optimize SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM) processes including purchasing, inventory management, invoice verification, and material master data. Manage full-cycle SAP Ariba implementations, ensuring seamless integration with SAP S/4HANA MM. Design and implement procurement workflows aligned with best practices and digital capabilities. Drive vendor onboarding and enablement strategies, ensuring compliance and data integrity. Implement and support VMI and Consignment programs to enhance inventory visibility and supplier collaboration. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful SAP implementation and change management. Provide expert guidance on procurement analytics, compliance, and continuous improvement. Assist with scoping prospective changes and advising business and ERP/IT leadership. Experience in project cutover, go-live, and hyper-care support. Data Management activities: Data Extraction, Cleansing, Mapping, Migration, and Reconciliation. Ensure solutions adhere to internal controls, SOX compliance, and audit standards. Design and implement seamless integration with other SAP modules and external systems. Maintain documentation of configurations, processes, and change management, using Signavio, SAP Cloud ALM and similar tools. Build trust with Supply Chain leaders and business process owners and share best practices and past experiences that will help with decision making. Collaborative, empathetic, and committed to sharing ideas and knowledge with cross-functional teams, project team members and delivery partners. Support change management and training initiatives to ensure user adoption. Mentor and provide technical leadership to SAP project teams, consultants, and offshore delivery partners. Assess updates in Materials Management, Ariba and related modules and recommend improvements for efficiency and automation. What sets you apart: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Information Systems, or related field. Experience: 8+ years of experience in SAP Procurement, with at least 3 years in Ariba Suite and S/4HANA Materials Management architecture and implementation. At least two full-cycle Ariba and S/4HANA implementations in an architect or lead role. Proven experience with SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud. Proven track record in large-scale ERP implementations, preferably in a global environment. Experience with Ariba downstream processes like Guided Buying, Catalog Management, and Invoice Management. Medical Device industry experience is a plus. Skills: Strong understanding of procurement business processes and how they translate into SAP solutions. Strong understanding of Supplier Lifecycle and Performance management processes. Good Understanding of VMI, Consignment and Outside Processing. Strong understanding of Ariba modules: Sourcing, Contracts, Buying & Invoicing, Supplier Lifecycle & Performance, and Business Network. Hands-on experience in configuration of SAP Materials Management for procurement, inventory management, invoice verification, and material master data. Skilled in data extraction, cleansing, mapping, migration, and reconciliation. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and evolving environment. Experience with Maquiladora setup is a plus. Experience with SAP Fiori, SimpleMDG, OneSource, WalkMe, OpenText, Cloud ALM, Signavio, Tricentis is a plus. Knowledge of SAP Activate Methodologies in a Plus. Certifications in SAP, preferably in Ariba and Procurement, is a plus. Travel This position may require 30% or more of your time traveling domestically and internationally to Integer manufacturing sites, customer sites, and supplier sites, as required. As such, you have a current passport and can secure appropriate visas, as required, for travel to international locations as specified. Preference will be given to US Citizens, EAD, and Green Card holders. &#xa;&#xa; Our total rewards program is designed to attract, retain, and motivate associates to contribute to Integer’s success. Our compensation program includes base salary and a cash-based incentive program supporting our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide a comprehensive benefits package with immediate eligibility including medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and adoption benefits. Parental leave is available after one year. Optional employee-paid programs include supplemental life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity and accident insurance. Employees are immediately eligible to participate in the 401(k) plan with company matching contributions. We provide 80 hours (10 days) of company designated holidays per year plus an annual allotment of paid time off. &#xa; U.S. Applicants: Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Enrollment Operations Specialist
jd_text: About Stride Stride helps independent workers access health, dental, and vision benefits. Stride is now part of Integrity, expanding the resources and capabilities available to the workers we serve. Position Details ● Seasonal W-2 employment beginning October 12, 2026 ● All Enrollment Operations Specialists are expected to remain through the December 31, 2026 CCA enrollment deadline. After December 31, the team will be reduced in phases based on enrollment volume and business needs, with individual assignments anticipated to end on January 15 or February 5, 2027. ● $23.00 per hour ● 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday, 8:00am–4:00pm PST ● Non-exempt and overtime eligible; additional hours may be available or required during peak periods based on business needs The Role We are looking for detail-oriented professionals to join our Enrollment Operations team during Open Enrollment.
